Name: Snack Stackers
Preparation: 1. Lay out Ritz Crackers on a flat surface.
2. Place a slice of Lunch Meat on each Ritz Cracker.
3. Add a slice of Cheese on top of the Lunch Meat.
4. Sprinkle a pinch of Black Pepper over the Cheese.
5. Add a dash of Paprika for extra flavor.
6. Stack another Ritz Cracker on top if desired, or serve as is.

Name: Chorizo and Egg Burritos
Preparation: 1. Finely chop the Onion.
2. In a skillet, cook the Chorizo over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the chopped Onion to the skillet and sauté until softened, about 3 minutes.
4. Crack the Egg into the skillet and scramble with the Chorizo and Onion mixture until fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Season the mixture with Paprika and Black Pepper, stirring well to combine.
6. Warm the Flour Tortilla in a separate pan or microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Place the Chorizo and Egg mixture in the center of the Flour Tortilla.
8. Fold the Flour Tortilla over the filling, tucking in the sides to form a burrito.
9. Serve immediately.

Name: Bow Tie Pepperoni Pasta Salad
Preparation: 1. Cook Bow Tie Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain and cool.
2. Slice Pepperoni into small pieces.
3. In a large bowl, combine cooled Bow Tie Pasta and sliced Pepperoni.
4. Pour Italian Dressing over the mixture and toss to coat evenly.
5. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese and Italian Seasoning on top.
6. Mix everything well and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

Name: BLT Pasta Salad
Preparation: 1. Cook Rotini Pasta according to package instructions, then drain and let it cool.
2. Cook Bacon until crispy, then crumble it into small pieces.
3. In a small bowl, mix Mayonnaise, Lemon Juice, Sugar, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil to make the dressing.
4. Chop Tomato, Green Onion, and Lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
5. In a large bowl, combine cooled Rotini Pasta, crumbled Bacon, chopped Tomato, Green Onion, and Lettuce.
6. Pour the dressing over the pasta mixture and toss to coat evenly.
7. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

Name: Cheese Tortellini Pesto Pasta Salad
Preparation: 1. Cook Cheese Tortellini and Rotini Pasta according to package instructions, then drain and let cool.
2. Chop Grape Tomatoes, Green Bell Pepper, and Artichoke Hearts into bite-sized pieces.
3. Mince Garlic finely.
4. In a large bowl, combine cooled Cheese Tortellini, Rotini Pasta, Grape Tomatoes, Green Bell Pepper, Artichoke Hearts, and Black Olives.
5. In a small bowl, mix Olive Oil, Basil Pesto, and minced Garlic to make the dressing.
6. Pour the dressing over the pasta mixture and toss to coat evenly.
7. Cube Mozzarella Cheese and add it to the salad, mixing gently.
8. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.
9. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to let flavors meld.

Name: Baked Chicken Tenders
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Coat Chicken Tenders with Light Mayonnaise evenly.
3. In a bowl, mix Breadcrumbs, Parmesan Cheese, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder.
4. Dredge the coated Chicken Tenders in the breadcrumb mixture until fully covered.
5. Place the Chicken Tenders on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden and cooked through.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Easy Enchiladas
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Cook Ground Beef in a skillet over medium heat until browned.
3. Drain excess fat from the skillet.
4. Stir in Enchilada Sauce, Dried Oregano, and Dried Basil into the cooked Ground Beef.
5. Simmer the mixture for 5 minutes.
6. Warm Corn Tortilla in a separate skillet or microwave to make it pliable.
7. Spoon the Ground Beef mixture onto the center of each Corn Tortilla.
8. Roll up the Corn Tortilla and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
9. Pour remaining Enchilada Sauce over the rolled tortillas.
10. Sprinkle Mexican Blend Cheese evenly on top.
11. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
12. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Fast Chicken and Rice
Preparation: 1. Cook White Rice according to package instructions and set aside.
2. Heat Cooking Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Chicken Breast to the pan and cook until fully done, about 5-7 minutes per side.
4. Cut cooked Chicken Breast into bite-sized pieces.
5. In the same pan, add Green Peas and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
6. Add cooked White Rice and Chicken Breast pieces back to the pan.
7. Pour Stir-fry Sauce over the mixture and stir well to combine.
8. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano, mixing evenly.
9. Add Almonds on top and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
10. Serve hot.

Name: 5 Ingredient Spaghetti
Preparation: 1. Boil Spaghetti in a large pot of salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. In a pan, heat Olive Oil over medium heat.
3. Add Garlic Powder and Paprika to the heated Olive Oil and stir for 1 minute.
4. Toss the cooked Spaghetti in the pan with the seasoned Olive Oil.
5. Stir in Lemon Juice and mix well to coat the Spaghetti.
6. Add chopped Basil and mix gently.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.

Name: Chicken Breast with Honey Balsamic Glaze
Preparation: 1. Season the Chicken Breast with Salt and Black Pepper on both sides.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
3. Add the Chicken Breast to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through.
4. In a small bowl, mix Balsamic Vinegar and Honey until well combined.
5. Pour the Honey and Balsamic Vinegar mixture over the Chicken Breast in the skillet.
6. Sprinkle Thyme over the Chicken Breast.
7. Simmer for 2-3 minutes, turning the Chicken Breast to coat it in the glaze.
8. Remove from heat and let it rest for 2 minutes before serving.

Name: Healthy Egg Salad Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Boil the Egg in water for 10 minutes, then cool and peel it.
2. Chop the peeled Egg into small pieces in a bowl.
3. Finely chop the Scallions and add them to the bowl with the Egg.
4. Add Dijon Mustard to the mixture and stir well to combine.
5. Sprinkle in Dried Basil and Paprika, mixing evenly.
6. Lay Lettuce on one slice of Whole Grain Bread.
7. Spread the Egg mixture over the Lettuce.
8. Top with another slice of Whole Grain Bread to complete the sandwich.
9. Cut the sandwich in half and serve.

Name: Lunchbox Pizza Quesadilla
Preparation: 1. Lay the Flour Tortilla flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread the Pizza Sauce evenly over half of the Flour Tortilla.
3. Sprinkle the Shredded Cheese over the Pizza Sauce.
4. Place the Pepperoni slices on top of the Shredded Cheese.
5. Fold the Flour Tortilla in half to cover the toppings.
6. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
7. Cook the folded Flour Tortilla for 2-3 minutes on each side until the Shredded Cheese melts and the tortilla is golden brown.
8. Remove from skillet, let cool slightly, and cut into wedges before serving.

Name: Ground Beef and Potatoes
Preparation:
1. Peel and dice the Potatoes into small cubes.
2. Heat Vegetable Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Lean Ground Beef to the pan and cook until browned.
4. Add diced Potatoes to the pan with the beef.
5. Sprinkle Salt over the mixture and stir well.
6. Cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until Potatoes are tender.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Cheesy Turkey Burger
Preparation: 1. In a bowl, mix Ground Turkey with Breadcrumbs, Worcestershire Sauce, and Garlic Powder.
2. Form the mixture into a patty shape.
3. Cook the patty in a skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
4. Add Cheddar Cheese on top of the patty during the last minute of cooking to melt.
5. Remove from skillet and serve hot.

Name: Tomato and Egg Muffin
Preparation: 1. Crack the Egg into a small bowl and whisk it lightly.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the Egg until fully scrambled or fried, about 2-3 minutes.
3. Toast the Multigrain English Muffin until golden brown.
4. Slice the Tomato into thin rounds, about 50.0 g worth.
5. Place the cooked Egg on the bottom half of the Multigrain English Muffin.
6. Layer the Tomato slices on top of the Egg.
7. Drizzle 5.0 ml of Balsamic Vinegar over the Tomato.
8. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Dried Basil and 1.0 tsp of Paprika evenly over the top.
9. Place the top half of the Multigrain English Muffin on the stack to complete the sandwich.
10. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Name: Easy Cheese-Tomato Melt
Preparation: 1. Slice the Tomato into thin rounds.
2. Cut the Low-fat Mozzarella Cheese into thin slices.
3. Place the Whole Wheat Bread on a baking tray.
4. Layer the Tomato slices on the Whole Wheat Bread.
5. Top the Tomato with Low-fat Mozzarella Cheese slices.
6. Sprinkle Italian Seasoning and Salt over the cheese.
7. Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5-7 minutes until the cheese melts.
8. Remove from oven and serve hot.

Name: Cheater's Chicken Noodle Soup
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken Tenders into small bite-sized pieces.
2. Peel and slice Carrots into thin rounds.
3. In a pot, bring Water to a boil and dissolve the Chicken Bouillon Cube in it.
4. Add Chicken Tenders and Carrots to the boiling water, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Add Egg Noodles to the pot and cook for 6-8 minutes until tender.
6. Stir in Dried Basil and Garlic Powder, then simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
7. Serve hot in bowls.

Name: Ground Chicken Ranch Burger
Preparation: 1. In a large bowl, combine Lean Ground Chicken, Breadcrumbs, Mushroom, Ranch Dressing Mix, Dried Basil, and Dried Oregano.
2. Mix the ingredients thoroughly until well blended.
3. Shape the mixture into patties of desired size.
4. Preheat a grill or skillet over medium heat.
5. Cook the patties for 5-6 minutes on each side or until fully cooked.
6. Serve hot on a bun or as desired.

Name: Mushroom Quesadilla
Preparation: 1. Clean and slice the Mushrooms (225.0 g) into thin pieces.
2. Mince the Garlic (5.0 g).
3. Heat a pan over medium heat and sauté the Mushrooms and Garlic until tender.
4. Add Salt (1.0 tsp) to the Mushroom mixture and stir well.
5. Place a Whole Wheat Tortilla (60.0 g) on a flat surface.
6. Sprinkle Cheddar Cheese (35.0 g) on half of the Whole Wheat Tortilla.
7. Spread the cooked Mushroom mixture over the Cheddar Cheese.
8. Fold the Whole Wheat Tortilla in half to cover the filling.
9. Heat a clean pan over medium heat and cook the quesadilla for 2-3 minutes on each side until the Cheddar Cheese melts and the Whole Wheat Tortilla is crispy.
10. Cut into wedges and serve hot.

Name: Boston Fenway Franks
Preparation: 1. Grill the Beef Frank over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally until evenly browned.
2. Toast the Hot Dog Bun lightly on the grill for 1-2 minutes.
3. Place the grilled Beef Frank inside the toasted Hot Dog Bun.
4. Spread Yellow Mustard over the Beef Frank.
5. Chop the Onion finely and sprinkle over the Yellow Mustard.
6. Add Sweet Pickle Relish on top of the Onion.
7. Sprinkle Dried Basil and Paprika evenly over the toppings.

Name: Original Praline Bacon
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Lay Bacon strips on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
3. In a small bowl, mix Brown Sugar, Garlic Powder, and Paprika.
4. Sprinkle the Brown Sugar mixture evenly over the Bacon.
5. Drizzle Cane Syrup over the Bacon strips.
6. Sprinkle chopped Pecans on top of the Bacon.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes until Bacon is crispy and caramelized.
8. Let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Lasagna
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a large skillet, cook Lean Ground Beef and Italian Sausage over medium heat until browned.
3. Add chopped Onion and minced Garlic to the skillet, and cook until softened.
4. Stir in chopped Tomatoes and Tomato Paste, then season with Black Pepper and Dried Oregano. Simmer for 10 minutes.
5. In a bowl, mix Ricotta Cheese with beaten Egg until smooth.
6. Cook Lasagna Noodles in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
7. In a baking dish, layer Lasagna Noodles, meat sauce, Ricotta Cheese mixture, and Mozzarella Cheese. Repeat layers.
8. Top with remaining Mozzarella Cheese and sprinkle Parmesan Cheese over it.
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
10. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Skillet Beans 'n Wieners
Preparation: 1. Heat Canola Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
2. Chop Bacon and Sweet Onion into small pieces.
3. Add Bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy.
4. Add Sweet Onion to the skillet and sauté until soft.
5. Slice Hot Dogs into bite-sized pieces.
6. Add Hot Dogs to the skillet and cook until lightly browned.
7. Stir in Pork and Beans, Ketchup, Honey Mustard, and Brown Sugar.
8. Season with Dried Oregano and Black Pepper.
9. Simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
10. Serve hot from the skillet.

Name: Baked Buffalo Wings
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Pat Chicken Wings dry with paper towels and place on a baking sheet.
3. Sprinkle Salt over Chicken Wings evenly.
4. Bake Chicken Wings for 40-45 minutes until crispy and golden.
5. In a small saucepan, melt Margarine over low heat.
6. Mix Hot Sauce, Cayenne Pepper, and Red Pepper Flakes into the melted Margarine.
7. Remove Chicken Wings from oven and toss them in the Hot Sauce mixture until fully coated.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Ratatouille in the Crock Pot
Preparation: 1. Chop Onion, Eggplant, Zucchini, Green Bell Pepper, and Tomato into small pieces.
2. Mince Garlic finely.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Sauté Onion and Garlic in the pan until fragrant.
5. Add Eggplant, Zucchini, and Green Bell Pepper to the pan and cook for 5 minutes.
6. Stir in Tomato and Tomato Paste, mixing well.
7. Sprinkle Sugar over the mixture and stir to combine.
8. Transfer all ingredients to a Crock Pot.
9. Cook on low heat in the Crock Pot for 6-8 hours until vegetables are tender.
10. Stir occasionally during cooking to ensure even blending of flavors.

Name: Baked Stuffed Pasta Shells
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cook Pasta Shells in boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
3. In a bowl, mix Ricotta Cheese, Mozzarella Cheese, Parmesan Cheese, Egg, Dried Basil, and Garlic Powder until well combined.
4. Stuff each cooked Pasta Shell with the cheese mixture.
5. Spread a thin layer of Tomato Sauce in a baking dish.
6. Place stuffed Pasta Shells in the dish over the Tomato Sauce.
7. Pour remaining Tomato Sauce over the stuffed shells.
8. Sprinkle extra Mozzarella Cheese on top if desired.
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
10. Let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Roasted Butternut Squash-Quinoa Veggie Burger
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Peel and cube Butternut Squash (100.0 g), toss with Olive Oil (10.0 ml), and roast for 25-30 minutes until soft.
3. Cook Quinoa (15.0 g) in water according to package instructions and let cool.
4. Mash roasted Butternut Squash in a bowl.
5. Mix in cooked Quinoa, Egg (0.17 large), Gruyere Cheese (20.0 g), Hazelnuts (10.0 g), Breadcrumbs (15.0 g), Dried Basil (1.0 tsp), and Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp).
6. Form mixture into a patty.
7. Heat a skillet over medium heat, add a little Olive Oil if needed, and cook patty for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden.
8. Place patty on a Whole Grain Bun (1.0 medium) and serve.

Name: Grilled Chicken Avocado Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Season the Chicken Breast with Salt and Black Pepper.
2. Grill the Chicken Breast until fully cooked, about 5-7 minutes per side.
3. Slice the grilled Chicken Breast into thin strips.
4. Mash the Avocado in a bowl until smooth.
5. Spread Mayonnaise on one side of each slice of Whole Grain Bread.
6. Spread the mashed Avocado on top of the Mayonnaise on one slice of Whole Grain Bread.
7. Place the sliced Chicken Breast on top of the Avocado.
8. Cover with the second slice of Whole Grain Bread, Mayonnaise side down.
9. Press the sandwich gently and serve.

Name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Soy Sauce
Preparation: 1. Heat Vegetable Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Mixed Vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes.
3. Pour Soy Sauce over the vegetables and mix well.
4. Sprinkle Paprika and Dried Basil over the mixture.
5. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until vegetables are tender.
6. Serve hot as a main course.

Name: Chicken Pasta with Tomato Sauce
Preparation:
1. Boil Pasta in water until cooked, then drain.
2. Cut Chicken Breast into small pieces.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Chicken Breast pieces to the pan and cook until golden.
5. Pour Tomato Sauce over the cooked Chicken Breast and stir well.
6. Add Salt to the sauce and mix thoroughly.
7. Mix the cooked Pasta with the Chicken and Tomato Sauce mixture.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Egg Fried Rice
Preparation: 1. Heat Vegetable Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Crack the Eggs into the pan and scramble them until fully cooked.
3. Add Cooked Rice to the pan and stir well to combine with the Eggs.
4. Pour Soy Sauce over the rice mixture and mix evenly.
5. Sprinkle Dried Basil and Garlic Powder into the pan.
6. Stir everything together for 2-3 minutes until well heated.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Turkey Cheese Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Take 2 medium slices of Bread and lay them flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread 10.0 g of Mustard evenly on one side of each Bread slice.
3. Place 80.0 g of Turkey Slices on one Bread slice over the Mustard.
4. Add 20.0 g of Cheese on top of the Turkey Slices.
5. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Dried Oregano and 1.0 tsp of Paprika over the Cheese.
6. Cover with the second Bread slice, Mustard side down, to form a sandwich.
7. Press gently and serve as is or cut into halves for easier handling.

Name: Chicken Fajita Wrap
Preparation:
1. Cut Chicken Breast into thin strips.
2. Slice Bell Peppers into thin strips.
3. Heat Vegetable Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Chicken Breast strips to the pan and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
5. Add Bell Peppers to the pan and cook for another 3-5 minutes until softened.
6. Stir in Fajita Sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes to coat evenly.
7. Warm the Flour Tortilla in a separate pan or microwave for 10-15 seconds.
8. Place the chicken and pepper mixture in the center of the Flour Tortilla.
9. Fold and wrap the Flour Tortilla tightly around the filling.
10. Serve immediately.

Name: Caprese Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Slice the Bread into two medium pieces.
2. Cut the Mozzarella Cheese into thin slices.
3. Slice the Tomato into thin rounds.
4. Layer the Mozzarella Cheese and Tomato slices on one piece of Bread.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil over the layered ingredients.
6. Sprinkle Salt and Black Pepper evenly on top.
7. Cover with the second piece of Bread to complete the sandwich.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Beef Stir Fry with Soy Sauce
Preparation: 1. Slice Lean Beef into thin strips.
2. Heat Vegetable Oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
3. Add Lean Beef to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned.
4. Add Mixed Vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes.
5. Pour Soy Sauce over the beef and vegetables, stirring to coat evenly.
6. Sprinkle Black Pepper and Dried Basil, and stir for 1 more minute.
7. Remove from heat and serve hot.

Name: Veggie Omelette
Preparation:
1. Crack 2 large Eggs into a bowl and whisk well.
2. Add 80.0 g of Mixed Vegetables to the Eggs and mix.
3. Season with 2.0 g of Salt and 1.0 g of Black Pepper.
4. Heat a pan over medium heat and melt 5.0 g of Butter.
5. Pour the Egg and Vegetable mixture into the pan.
6. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is set, then flip.
7. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until fully cooked.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Salad with Dressing
Preparation: 1. Cook the Chicken Breast in a pan until fully cooked, then let it cool.
2. Shred the cooked Chicken Breast into bite-sized pieces.
3. Wash and chop the Lettuce into manageable pieces.
4. In a large bowl, combine the shredded Chicken Breast and chopped Lettuce.
5. Drizzle the Salad Dressing over the mixture.
6. Sprinkle Paprika and Dried Oregano on top.
7. Toss everything together until well mixed.
8. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator before serving.

Name: Grilled Fish with Lemon Butter
Preparation: 1. Season the Fish Fillet with Salt and Black Pepper on both sides.
2. Heat a grill pan over medium heat.
3. Place the Fish Fillet on the grill pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
4. In a small pan, melt the Butter over low heat.
5. Add Lemon Juice to the melted Butter and stir well to combine.
6. Pour the Lemon Butter sauce over the grilled Fish Fillet before serving.

Name: Chicken Stir Fry with Vegetables
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken Breast into small, bite-sized pieces.
2. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Chicken Breast pieces to the pan and cook until golden brown.
4. Add Mixed Vegetables to the pan and stir well.
5. Pour Soy Sauce over the mixture and mix evenly.
6. Sprinkle Paprika and Dried Oregano, stirring to combine.
7. Cook for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is fully cooked.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Omelette
Preparation:
1. Beat 3 large Eggs in a bowl.
2. Add 2.0 g Salt and 1.0 g Black Pepper to the Eggs and mix well.
3. Shred 80.0 g Chicken into small pieces.
4. Heat 5.0 ml Oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
5. Add shredded Chicken to the pan and cook until lightly browned.
6. Pour the Egg mixture over the Chicken in the pan.
7. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is set.
8. Flip the omelette and cook for another 2-3 minutes until fully cooked.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
Preparation:
1. Heat Oil in a pot over medium heat.
2. Add chopped Onion and Garlic, sauté until golden.
3. Add Chicken, cook until lightly browned.
4. Stir in Mixed Vegetables and mix well.
5. Add water to cover ingredients, bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat, simmer for 20 minutes until Chicken is tender.
7. Season with Salt and Black Pepper, stir well.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Egg and Vegetable Stir Fry
Preparation: 1. Beat the 3 large Eggs in a bowl and set aside.
2. Heat 5.0 ml of Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add 100.0 g of Mixed Vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
4. Pour the beaten Eggs into the pan with the vegetables.
5. Stir continuously to scramble the Eggs with the Mixed Vegetables until fully cooked.
6. Add 2.0 g of Salt and mix well.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Capsicum Stir Fry
Preparation:
1. Cut Chicken into small pieces.
2. Slice Capsicum and Onion thinly.
3. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Chicken to the pan and cook until browned.
5. Add Onion and Capsicum to the pan, stir well.
6. Sprinkle Salt and Black Pepper over the mixture.
7. Stir fry for 5-7 minutes until vegetables are tender.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
Preparation:
1. Crack 3 large Eggs into a bowl and whisk them.
2. Heat 10 g of Butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Pour the whisked Eggs into the pan and stir gently.
4. Add 1 g of Salt and 0.5 g of Black Pepper to the Eggs while stirring.
5. Cook the Eggs until they are softly set, then remove from heat.
6. Toast 2 medium slices of Whole Wheat Bread until golden brown.
7. Place the scrambled Eggs on top of the toasted Whole Wheat Bread.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Oats Porridge with Banana
Preparation: 1. In a saucepan, combine 60.0 g of Oats with 150.0 ml of Milk.
2. Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the Oats are soft and creamy (about 5 minutes).
3. Slice 100.0 g of Banana into small pieces.
4. Once the Oats are cooked, remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.
5. Top the Oats Porridge with the sliced Banana.
6. Drizzle 10.0 g of Honey over the top.
7. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Dried Basil and 1.0 tsp of Garlic Powder on the porridge as a garnish.
8. Serve warm and enjoy.

Name: Fruit Salad with Yogurt
Preparation: 1. Wash and chop 150.0 g of Mixed Fruits into bite-sized pieces.
2. Place the chopped Mixed Fruits in a mixing bowl.
3. Add 100.0 g of Yogurt to the bowl with the Mixed Fruits.
4. Drizzle 5.0 g of Honey over the mixture.
5. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Dried Basil and 1.0 tsp of Paprika on top.
6. Gently mix all ingredients until well combined.
7. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator before serving.

Name: Boiled Egg Salad
Preparation:
1. Boil the Egg for 10-12 minutes, then cool and peel them.
2. Chop the Lettuce and Tomato into small pieces.
3. Slice the boiled Egg into halves or quarters.
4. In a bowl, mix the Lettuce, Tomato, and Egg.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil and Lemon Juice over the mixture.
6. Sprinkle Paprika and Black Pepper on top.
7. Toss gently to combine all ingredients.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Banana Smoothie
Preparation: 1. Peel the Banana and cut it into small pieces.
2. Add the Banana pieces to a blender.
3. Pour in the Milk.
4. Add Honey to the blender.
5. Sprinkle in the Paprika and Dried Basil.
6. Blend all ingredients until smooth.
7. Pour the Banana Smoothie into a glass and serve chilled.

Name: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
Preparation: 1. Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
2. Rub Salmon Fillet with Olive Oil, Paprika, and Dried Oregano.
3. Mince Garlic and mix with Lemon Juice to create a marinade.
4. Brush the marinade over the Salmon Fillet.
5. Trim Asparagus and lightly coat with remaining Olive Oil.
6. Place Salmon Fillet and Asparagus on the grill.
7. Grill Salmon for 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
8. Grill Asparagus for 3-4 minutes until tender.
9. Remove from grill and serve immediately.

Name: Vegetable Fried Rice
Preparation: 1. Heat Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
3. Add Mixed Vegetables and cook for 5-7 minutes until tender.
4. Stir in Cooked Rice and mix well with the vegetables.
5. Pour Soy Sauce over the rice mixture and stir to combine.
6. Add Paprika and Dried Basil, mixing evenly.
7. Garnish with chopped Spring Onion before serving.

Name: Mushroom Risotto
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add chopped Onion and sauté until translucent.
3. Add sliced Mushrooms and cook until softened.
4. Stir in Arborio Rice and cook for 1-2 minutes to toast lightly.
5. Gradually add hot water or broth, stirring constantly, until Rice is creamy and cooked.
6. Stir in Butter and grated Parmesan Cheese until melted and combined.
7. Season with Black Pepper and Dried Basil.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Salad
Preparation: 1. Marinate Chicken Breast with Paprika and Garlic Powder for 15 minutes.
2. Heat a grill pan over medium heat and add Olive Oil.
3. Grill Chicken Breast for 5-7 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
4. Wash and chop Lettuce, Tomato, and Cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
5. Mix the chopped vegetables in a bowl to prepare the salad.
6. Drizzle Lemon Juice over the salad and toss lightly.
7. Slice the grilled Chicken Breast and place it on top of the salad.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Pasta Primavera
Preparation: 1. Boil Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
4. Add Mixed Vegetables and cook until tender.
5. Toss in the cooked Pasta and mix well.
6. Season with Black Pepper and Paprika.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.

Name: Chicken Caesar Salad
Preparation: 1. Season Chicken Breast with Garlic Powder and Paprika.
2. Grill or pan-cook Chicken Breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
3. Chop Romaine Lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
4. In a large bowl, combine Romaine Lettuce, sliced Chicken Breast, and Croutons.
5. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese over the mixture.
6. Drizzle Caesar Dressing evenly on top.
7. Toss everything together to coat with dressing.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Warm Lemon Water with Honey
Preparation: 1. Heat 200.0 ml of Water in a small pot until warm.
2. Pour the warm Water into a glass or mug.
3. Add 15.0 ml of Lemon Juice to the Water and stir well.
4. Mix in 10.0 g of Honey until fully dissolved.
5. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Dried Oregano into the mixture.
6. Add 1.0 tsp of Black Pepper and stir gently.
7. Serve immediately while still warm.

Name: Green Tea with Dates
Preparation: 1. Boil 200.0 ml of Green Tea in a pot for 5 minutes.
2. Chop 20.0 g of Dates into small pieces.
3. Add the chopped Dates to the boiling Green Tea.
4. Stir in 1.0 tsp of Black Pepper and 1.0 tsp of Garlic Powder.
5. Simmer the mixture for 2-3 minutes.
6. Strain the Green Tea with Dates into a cup and serve hot.

Name: Chamomile Tea
Preparation: 1. Boil 200.0 ml of Water in a kettle or pot.
2. Place 1.0 small Chamomile Tea Bag in a cup.
3. Pour the boiled Water over the Chamomile Tea Bag.
4. Let it steep for 5-7 minutes.
5. Remove the Chamomile Tea Bag from the cup.
6. Add 5.0 g of Honey and stir well.
7. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Black Pepper and 1.0 tsp of Dried Oregano into the tea.
8. Stir gently and serve hot.

Name: Banana with Peanut Butter
Preparation: 1. Peel the Banana and place it on a plate.
2. Spread Peanut Butter evenly over the Banana.
3. Sprinkle Black Pepper over the Peanut Butter.
4. Dust Garlic Powder lightly on top.
5. Slice the Banana into bite-sized pieces if desired.
6. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Name: Chicken Noodle Soup
Preparation:
1. Heat Oil in a pot over medium heat.
2. Add chopped Onion, Carrots, and Celery; cook until softened.
3. Add Chicken, cut into small pieces, and cook until browned.
4. Pour in water or broth to cover ingredients, bring to a boil.
5. Add Noodles and simmer until tender.
6. Season with Dried Basil and Paprika; stir well.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Wrap with Hummus
Preparation: 1. Season the Chicken Breast with Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano.
2. Cook the Chicken Breast in a pan over medium heat until fully cooked, about 6-8 minutes per side.
3. Slice the cooked Chicken Breast into thin strips.
4. Lay the Flour Tortilla flat on a clean surface.
5. Spread Hummus evenly over the Flour Tortilla.
6. Layer the sliced Chicken Breast, Lettuce, Tomato, and Cucumber on top of the Hummus.
7. Roll the Flour Tortilla tightly to enclose the fillings.
8. Slice the wrap in half if desired, and serve immediately.

Name: Grilled Paneer Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Slice Paneer into thin pieces.
2. Chop Bell Peppers and Onion finely.
3. Heat a pan and lightly toast Whole Wheat Bread slices.
4. Spread Butter on one side of each Whole Wheat Bread slice.
5. Place Paneer slices, chopped Bell Peppers, Onion, and Lettuce on one bread slice.
6. Cover with another bread slice, buttered side down.
7. Grill the sandwich in a pan or sandwich maker until golden brown on both sides.
8. Cut into halves and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
Preparation: 1. Marinate Chicken Breast with Garlic Powder and Paprika for 30 minutes.
2. Grill or cook Chicken Breast in a pan until fully cooked, then slice into thin strips.
3. Warm the Flour Tortilla on a pan for 1-2 minutes.
4. Spread Garlic Sauce evenly over the Flour Tortilla.
5. Layer Lettuce and Tomato on top of the Garlic Sauce.
6. Add sliced Chicken Breast over the vegetables.
7. Roll the Flour Tortilla tightly to form a wrap.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Grilled Fish with Mashed Potatoes
Preparation: 1. Marinate the Fish Fillet with Olive Oil, Lemon Juice, Paprika, and Dried Oregano for 15 minutes.
2. Peel and boil Potatoes in water until soft, about 15-20 minutes.
3. Drain Potatoes and mash them with Butter and Milk until smooth.
4. Heat a grill pan over medium heat and grill the marinated Fish Fillet for 3-4 minutes on each side until cooked through.
5. Serve the Grilled Fish alongside the Mashed Potatoes.

Name: Chicken Fried Rice
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken Breast into small pieces.
2. Heat Oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat.
3. Add Chicken Breast pieces and cook until browned.
4. Push Chicken to one side of the pan, crack the Egg into the other side, and scramble it.
5. Add Mixed Vegetables to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
6. Add Cooked Rice to the pan and mix well with other ingredients.
7. Pour Soy Sauce over the mixture and stir to combine.
8. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Paprika, and mix evenly.
9. Add chopped Spring Onion, stir for another minute, and serve hot.

Name: Turkey Club Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Toast the Whole Wheat Bread slices until golden brown.
2. Cook the Bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
3. Slice the Turkey Breast into thin pieces if not pre-sliced.
4. Wash and pat dry the Lettuce leaves.
5. Slice the Tomato into thin rounds.
6. Spread Mayonnaise on one side of each slice of Whole Wheat Bread.
7. Sprinkle Paprika and Garlic Powder over the Mayonnaise on each slice.
8. Layer Turkey Breast, Bacon, Lettuce, and Tomato on one slice of bread.
9. Top with another slice of bread, Mayonnaise side down.
10. Repeat for a triple-decker sandwich using the third slice of bread, if desired.
11. Cut the sandwich into halves or quarters and serve.

Name: Shepherd's Pie
Preparation:
1. Peel and boil Potatoes until soft, then mash with Butter.
2. Heat Oil in a pan and sauté chopped Onion until golden.
3. Add Minced Lamb to the pan and cook until browned.
4. Stir in Mixed Vegetables, Dried Basil, and Paprika, and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Transfer the lamb and vegetable mixture to a baking dish.
6. Spread the mashed Potatoes evenly over the top.
7. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes or until golden on top.

Name: Shrimp Pasta
Preparation: 1. Cook Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add minced Garlic and Red Chili Flakes to the pan, sauté for 1 minute.
4. Add Shrimp to the pan, season with Paprika and Garlic Powder, and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Toss the cooked Pasta into the pan with the Shrimp mixture, mixing well to coat.
6. Garnish with chopped Parsley before serving.

Name: BBQ Chicken Wings
Preparation: 1. Rinse and pat dry the Chicken Wings (200.0 g).
2. In a bowl, mix BBQ Sauce (30.0 g), Oil (5.0 ml), minced Garlic (3.0 g), Black Pepper (1.0 tsp), and Dried Oregano (1.0 tsp).
3. Coat the Chicken Wings evenly with the mixture and let them marinate for 30 minutes.
4. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
5. Place the marinated Chicken Wings on a baking tray.
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
Preparation: 1. Season Chicken Breast with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
2. Grill Chicken Breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
3. Chop Cucumber and Tomato into bite-sized pieces.
4. Thinly slice Red Onion.
5. In a large bowl, combine Cucumber, Tomato, Red Onion, and Olives.
6. Crumble Feta Cheese over the vegetable mixture.
7. Drizzle Olive Oil over the salad.
8. Top the salad with grilled Chicken Breast strips.
9. Toss gently to combine all ingredients.

Name: Lemon Chicken with Rice
Preparation:
1. Marinate Chicken Breast with Lemon Juice, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil for 30 minutes.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Garlic to the pan and sauté for 1 minute.
4. Place marinated Chicken Breast in the pan and cook for 6-8 minutes on each side until golden brown.
5. Add Butter to the pan and baste the chicken for 1 minute.
6. Serve the cooked Chicken Breast over a bed of Cooked Rice.

Name: Prawn Fried Rice
Preparation: 1. Heat Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Prawns and cook until pink, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Push Prawns to one side, crack the Egg into the pan, and scramble it.
4. Stir in Mixed Vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
5. Add Cooked Rice to the pan and mix well with other ingredients.
6. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Dried Basil over the mixture and stir.
7. Drizzle Soy Sauce evenly and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Quesadilla
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken Breast into small pieces.
2. Slice Bell Peppers and Onion thinly.
3. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Cook Chicken Breast pieces in the pan until fully cooked.
5. Add Bell Peppers and Onion to the pan and sauté until tender.
6. Place one Flour Tortilla on a flat surface.
7. Sprinkle half of the Cheddar Cheese on one half of the Flour Tortilla.
8. Add the cooked Chicken Breast, Bell Peppers, and Onion on top of the cheese.
9. Sprinkle the remaining Cheddar Cheese over the mixture.
10. Fold the Flour Tortilla in half to cover the filling.
11. Heat the folded Flour Tortilla in a clean pan over medium heat.
12. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until the tortilla is golden and cheese is melted.
13. Repeat with the second Flour Tortilla if needed.
14. Cut into wedges and serve hot.

Name: Stuffed Bell Pepper
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Cut the tops off the Bell Peppers and remove the seeds.
3. Chop the Onion finely.
4. Heat Oil in a pan and sauté the Onion until soft.
5. Mix the sautéed Onion with Cooked Rice and Mixed Vegetables in a bowl.
6. Stuff the mixture into the hollowed Bell Peppers.
7. Top each stuffed Bell Pepper with Cheese.
8. Place the stuffed Bell Peppers in a baking dish.
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes until the Bell Peppers are tender and the Cheese is melted.

Name: Chicken Schnitzel with Coleslaw
Preparation: 1. Pound the Chicken Breast to an even thickness.
2. Beat the Egg in a bowl.
3. Mix Breadcrumbs with Paprika and Dried Basil in a separate bowl.
4. Dip the Chicken Breast in the Egg, then coat with the Breadcrumb mixture.
5. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
6. Fry the coated Chicken Breast in the Oil until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
7. Shred Cabbage and Carrot into thin strips.
8. Mix shredded Cabbage and Carrot with Mayonnaise to make coleslaw.
9. Serve the cooked Chicken Schnitzel with the prepared Coleslaw on the side.

Name: Lentil and Mushroom Shepherd's Pie
Preparation: 1. Rinse and cook Brown Lentils in water until tender, then drain.
2. Boil Potato until soft, then mash with Butter and set aside.
3. Chop Mushrooms and Carrot into small pieces.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a pan and sauté Mushrooms and Carrot until soft.
5. Add cooked Brown Lentils to the pan with Mushrooms and Carrot.
6. Season the mixture with Dried Basil and Garlic Powder, stirring well.
7. Transfer the lentil and vegetable mixture to a baking dish.
8. Spread the mashed Potato evenly over the top of the mixture.
9. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden on top.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Caprese Zucchini Noodles
Preparation: 1. Spiralize the Zucchini (200.0 g) into noodle shapes using a spiralizer.
2. Halve the Cherry Tomatoes (100.0 g) and set aside.
3. Tear the Mozzarella Cheese (30.0 g) into small pieces.
4. In a large bowl, combine the Zucchini noodles, Cherry Tomatoes, and Mozzarella Cheese.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil (10.0 ml) and Balsamic Vinegar (5.0 ml) over the mixture.
6. Sprinkle Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp) and Dried Oregano (1.0 tsp) evenly.
7. Tear Fresh Basil (10.0 g) into pieces and add to the bowl.
8. Toss everything together gently to combine flavors.
9. Serve immediately as a fresh dish.

Name: Quinoa Veggie Burger
Preparation:
1. Cook Quinoa in water until tender, then drain and set aside.
2. Mash Black Beans in a bowl until smooth.
3. Boil and mash Sweet Potato, then mix with Black Beans and Quinoa.
4. Add Breadcrumbs, Garlic Powder, and Paprika to the mixture and combine well.
5. Form the mixture into patties.
6. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
7. Cook patties for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
8. Serve patties on a bed of Mixed Salad Greens.

Name: Creamy Arborio Mushroom Risotto
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Finely chop Onion and sauté in the pan until translucent.
3. Add sliced Mushrooms and cook until softened.
4. Stir in Arborio Rice and cook for 1-2 minutes to toast lightly.
5. Gradually add Vegetable Broth, stirring constantly, allowing the rice to absorb the liquid.
6. Continue adding Vegetable Broth in small amounts, stirring until the rice is creamy and tender.
7. Season with Paprika and Dried Oregano, mixing well.
8. Stir in grated Parmesan Cheese until melted and combined.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Greek Chickpea Salad
Preparation: 1. Rinse and drain the Chickpeas thoroughly.
2. Dice the Cucumber into small pieces.
3. Halve the Cherry Tomatoes.
4. Crumble the Feta Cheese into small chunks.
5. Pit and halve the Kalamata Olives if needed.
6. In a large bowl, combine Chickpeas, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Feta Cheese, and Kalamata Olives.
7. Drizzle Olive Oil over the mixture.
8. Sprinkle Dried Oregano and Dried Basil on top.
9. Toss everything together until well mixed.
10. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

Name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
Preparation: 1. Cook Jumbo Pasta Shells in boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. In a pan, sauté Spinach with Garlic until wilted, then let it cool.
3. Mix Ricotta Cheese with the cooled Spinach, Paprika, and Garlic Powder in a bowl.
4. Stuff the cooked Jumbo Pasta Shells with the Ricotta and Spinach mixture.
5. Spread half of the Marinara Sauce in a baking dish, then arrange the stuffed shells on top.
6. Pour the remaining Marinara Sauce over the shells.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top of the shells.
8. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

Name: Veggie Pesto Wrap
Preparation: 1. Heat a pan over medium heat and add Olive Oil.
2. Slice Zucchini and Bell Pepper into thin strips.
3. Sauté Zucchini and Bell Pepper in the pan for 3-5 minutes until slightly tender.
4. Lay the Whole Wheat Tortilla flat on a clean surface.
5. Spread Pesto Sauce evenly over the Whole Wheat Tortilla.
6. Place the sautéed Zucchini and Bell Pepper in the center of the tortilla.
7. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese over the vegetables.
8. Fold and roll the Whole Wheat Tortilla tightly to form a wrap.
9. Optionally, grill the wrap in the pan for 1-2 minutes on each side to make it crispy.
10. Slice the wrap in half and serve warm.

Name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
Preparation: 1. Chop Broccoli and Potato into small pieces.
2. Melt Butter in a pot over medium heat.
3. Add chopped Broccoli and Potato to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes.
4. Pour in Vegetable Broth and bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
6. Stir in Milk, Paprika, and Black Pepper.
7. Add grated Cheddar Cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
8. Blend the mixture until creamy using a blender or immersion blender.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Ratatouille
Preparation:
1. Wash and chop Eggplant, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, and Tomato into bite-sized pieces.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add Eggplant and Zucchini to the pan, cook for 5 minutes until slightly softened.
4. Add Bell Pepper and Tomato to the pan, stir well.
5. Sprinkle Herbes de Provence over the vegetables, mix evenly.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Check if vegetables are tender, then remove from heat and serve.

Name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowl
Preparation: 1. Peel and dice the Sweet Potato into small cubes.
2. Toss the Sweet Potato cubes with Olive Oil, Cumin Powder, Black Pepper, and Dried Oregano.
3. Roast the seasoned Sweet Potato in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 25-30 minutes until tender.
4. Rinse and drain the Black Beans if using canned, or cook if using dry beans.
5. Slice the Avocado into thin pieces.
6. In a bowl, combine the roasted Sweet Potato and Black Beans.
7. Top the bowl with sliced Avocado.
8. Drizzle Lime Juice over the bowl before serving.

Name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
Preparation: 1. Season Chicken Breast with Paprika and Dried Basil.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a grill pan over medium heat.
3. Grill Chicken Breast for 6-8 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
4. Slice the grilled Chicken Breast into thin strips.
5. Lay the Whole Wheat Tortilla flat on a clean surface.
6. Place Romaine Lettuce evenly over the Whole Wheat Tortilla.
7. Add the sliced Chicken Breast on top of the Romaine Lettuce.
8. Drizzle Caesar Dressing over the chicken.
9. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top.
10. Fold and roll the Whole Wheat Tortilla tightly to form a wrap.
11. Serve immediately or wrap in foil for later.

Name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Place the Salmon on a baking tray.
3. Arrange the Asparagus around the Salmon.
4. Drizzle Olive Oil over the Salmon and Asparagus.
5. Squeeze Lemon juice over the Salmon.
6. Mince Garlic and sprinkle it over the Salmon and Asparagus.
7. Season with Black Pepper.
8. Bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes until Salmon is cooked through.

Name: Chicken Alfredo Penne
Preparation:
1. Boil Penne Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Cut Chicken into small pieces and season with Paprika.
3. In a pan, melt Butter and sauté Garlic until fragrant.
4. Add Chicken to the pan and cook until fully done.
5. Pour in Heavy Cream and stir in Parmesan Cheese until melted.
6. Add Dried Basil and mix well.
7. Toss the cooked Penne Pasta into the sauce and coat evenly.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
Preparation: 1. Drain and rinse the Cannellini Beans.
2. Drain the Canned Tuna and flake it into a bowl.
3. Finely chop the Red Onion and add it to the bowl.
4. Add the rinsed Cannellini Beans to the bowl with Tuna and Red Onion.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil and Lemon Juice over the mixture.
6. Finely chop the Parsley and sprinkle it into the bowl.
7. Add Paprika and Garlic Powder to the mixture.
8. Toss all ingredients together until well combined.
9. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes.

Name: Double Decker Turkey Club
Preparation: 1. Toast the Whole Wheat Bread slices until golden brown.
2. Spread Mayonnaise evenly on one side of each bread slice.
3. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Dried Basil over the Mayonnaise on each slice.
4. Layer Turkey Breast Slices on the bottom bread slice.
5. Add Bacon on top of the Turkey Breast Slices.
6. Place Tomato slices over the Bacon.
7. Add Lettuce on top of the Tomato.
8. Cover with the second bread slice, Mayonnaise side down.
9. Cut the sandwich diagonally into halves or quarters and serve.

Name: Beef Bolognese with Zoodles
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add chopped Onion and minced Garlic, sauté until soft.
3. Add Minced Beef, cook until browned.
4. Stir in Crushed Tomatoes, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder.
5. Simmer the mixture for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Spiralize Zucchini into zoodles using a spiralizer.
7. Lightly sauté Zucchini zoodles in a separate pan for 2-3 minutes.
8. Serve the Beef Bolognese sauce over the Zucchini zoodles.

Name: Lemon Herb Chicken Quinoa
Preparation: 1. Rinse Quinoa under cold water and cook in a pot with water until tender, then set aside.
2. Season Chicken Breast with Garlic Powder on both sides.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add seasoned Chicken Breast to the pan and cook for 6-8 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
5. Drizzle Lemon Juice over the cooked Chicken Breast.
6. Chop Fresh Parsley and sprinkle over the Chicken Breast.
7. Serve the Chicken Breast over a bed of cooked Quinoa.

Name: Shrimp Scampi
Preparation: 1. Cook Linguine Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
2. Melt Butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add Garlic to the skillet and sauté until fragrant.
4. Add Shrimp to the skillet and cook until pink and opaque.
5. Stir in Lemon Juice and Red Pepper Flakes, mixing well.
6. Toss the cooked Linguine Pasta with the Shrimp mixture in the skillet.
7. Serve hot and enjoy.

Name: Chicken & Mushroom Crepes
Preparation: 1. Prepare and cook the Crepes, then set aside.
2. Dice the Chicken into small pieces.
3. Slice the Mushrooms thinly.
4. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
5. Add Chicken to the pan and cook until browned.
6. Add Mushrooms to the pan and sauté until soft.
7. Pour in Heavy Cream and stir well.
8. Season with Thyme, Dried Oregano, and Black Pepper.
9. Simmer the mixture until it thickens slightly.
10. Spoon the Chicken and Mushroom mixture onto each Crepe.
11. Fold or roll the Crepes to enclose the filling.
12. Serve warm.

Name: Pork Snitzel with Potato Salad
Preparation: 1. Tenderize the Pork Loin by pounding it to an even thickness.
2. Season the Pork Loin with Garlic Powder and Black Pepper.
3. Coat the seasoned Pork Loin in Breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Fry the breaded Pork Loin in the hot Olive Oil until golden and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
6. Boil the Potato in salted water until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
7. Drain and cool the Potato, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
8. In a bowl, mix Apple Cider Vinegar and Mustard to make a dressing.
9. Toss the Potato pieces in the dressing to make Potato Salad.
10. Serve the Pork Schnitzel hot with the Potato Salad on the side.

Name: Vegetable Lasagna
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cook Lasagna Noodles in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan and sauté Spinach until wilted.
4. In a bowl, mix Ricotta Cheese with sautéed Spinach, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil.
5. Spread a thin layer of Marinara Sauce in a baking dish.
6. Layer Lasagna Noodles over the Marinara Sauce.
7. Add a layer of the Ricotta Cheese and Spinach mixture.
8. Repeat layers of Marinara Sauce, Lasagna Noodles, and Ricotta mixture.
9. Top with Mozzarella Cheese.
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
11. Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Eggplant Parmesan
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice Eggplant into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
3. Coat Eggplant slices with Breadcrumbs evenly.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
5. Fry breaded Eggplant slices until golden on both sides.
6. In a baking dish, spread a layer of Marinara Sauce.
7. Place fried Eggplant slices over the Marinara Sauce.
8. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese and Parmesan Cheese over Eggplant.
9. Add Dried Oregano and Garlic Powder on top.
10. Repeat layers with remaining Eggplant, Marinara Sauce, and cheeses.
11. Bake for 25-30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
12. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Mushroom Stroganoff
Preparation: 1. Cook Egg-Free Noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain and set aside.
2. Slice Mushrooms and chop Onion finely.
3. Melt Butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Onion to the pan and sauté until translucent.
5. Add sliced Mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their juices.
6. Pour Vegetable Broth into the pan and bring to a simmer.
7. Stir in Sour Cream, Dried Basil, and Black Pepper until well combined.
8. Simmer the mixture for 5 minutes until thickened.
9. Add cooked Egg-Free Noodles to the pan and toss to coat in the sauce.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cut the top off each Bell Pepper and remove seeds.
3. Cook Quinoa according to package instructions.
4. In a bowl, mix cooked Quinoa, Black Beans, and Corn.
5. Stuff the mixture into each Bell Pepper.
6. Top each stuffed Bell Pepper with Salsa.
7. Place stuffed Bell Peppers in a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
8. Sprinkle Cheddar Cheese on top and bake for an additional 5 minutes until melted.
9. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pot over medium heat.
2. Add Tomato Soup Base to the pot and stir well.
3. Sprinkle in Garlic Powder and Paprika, mixing to combine.
4. Simmer the soup for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Chop Fresh Basil and stir into the soup just before serving.
6. Spread Butter on one side of each slice of Whole Wheat Bread.
7. Place Cheddar Cheese between two slices of bread, buttered side out.
8. Heat a skillet over medium heat and grill the sandwich until golden on both sides.
9. Cut the grilled cheese sandwich into halves or quarters.
10. Serve the Creamy Tomato Basil Soup hot with the Grilled Cheese on the side.

Name: Butternut Squash Risotto
Preparation: 1. Peel and dice the Butternut Squash into small cubes.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add the diced Butternut Squash to the pan and sauté for 5 minutes.
4. Stir in Arborio Rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly toasted.
5. Gradually add Vegetable Broth, 50 ml at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed.
6. Continue adding Vegetable Broth and stirring until the rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes).
7. Mix in Garlic Powder and Dried Basil for flavor.
8. Add Parmesan Cheese and stir until melted and combined.
9. Finely chop Sage Leaves and sprinkle over the risotto as a garnish.
10. Serve hot and enjoy.

Name: Margherita Pita Pizza
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Place the Pita Bread on a baking tray.
3. Spread Marinara Sauce evenly over the Pita Bread.
4. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese on top of the sauce.
5. Slice Cherry Tomatoes and arrange them over the cheese.
6. Drizzle Olive Oil over the top.
7. Sprinkle Black Pepper and Dried Oregano evenly.
8. Bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes until the cheese melts and edges are crispy.
9. Remove from oven and top with Fresh Basil leaves before serving.

Name: Gnocchi with Gorgonzola Cream Sauce
Preparation: 1. Cook Potato Gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
2. In a saucepan, melt Butter over medium heat.
3. Add Heavy Cream to the saucepan and stir until warmed through.
4. Crumble Gorgonzola Cheese into the cream mixture and stir until melted and smooth.
5. Add cooked Potato Gnocchi to the sauce and toss to coat evenly.
6. Sprinkle Black Pepper over the gnocchi and mix gently.
7. Top with chopped Walnuts before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Couscous Salad
Preparation: 1. Cook Couscous according to package instructions and let it cool.
2. Drain and rinse Chickpeas, then set aside.
3. Dice Zucchini into small pieces.
4. Crumble Feta Cheese into a bowl.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together Olive Oil, Lemon Juice, Black Pepper, and Garlic Powder to make a dressing.
6. In a large bowl, combine cooled Couscous, Chickpeas, Zucchini, and Feta Cheese.
7. Pour the dressing over the mixture and toss to combine.
8. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: Vegetable Pot Pie
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Chop Mixed Root Veggies into small, even pieces.
3. In a saucepan, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Stir in Flour to form a roux, cook for 1 minute.
5. Gradually whisk in Vegetable Broth and Heavy Cream until smooth.
6. Add Dried Basil and Dried Oregano, stir well.
7. Mix in chopped Mixed Root Veggies and cook until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
8. Transfer the veggie mixture into a baking dish.
9. Cover the mixture with Puff Pastry Sheet, trimming edges if needed.
10. Cut small slits in the Puff Pastry Sheet for steam to escape.
11. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
12. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Steak and Mashed Potatoes
Preparation: 1. Season the Beef Steak with Black Pepper and Paprika on both sides.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Cook the Beef Steak in the skillet for 3-5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness.
4. Remove the Beef Steak from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
5. Peel and chop the Potato into small chunks.
6. Boil the Potato chunks in water for 15-20 minutes or until soft.
7. Drain the Potato and mash it in a bowl.
8. Add Butter and Milk to the mashed Potato, and mix until smooth.
9. Steam the Green Beans for 5-7 minutes until tender.
10. Serve the Beef Steak with mashed Potato and Green Beans on the side.

Name: Chicken Parmesan
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Coat Chicken Breast with Breadcrumbs, Garlic Powder, and Paprika.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Cook Chicken Breast in the pan until golden on both sides (about 3-4 minutes per side).
5. Place cooked Chicken Breast in a baking dish.
6. Pour Marinara Sauce over the Chicken Breast.
7. Top with Mozzarella Cheese.
8. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
9. Meanwhile, boil Spaghetti in salted water until al dente (about 8-10 minutes).
10. Drain Spaghetti and serve with the baked Chicken Breast on top.

Name: Lemon Butter Baked Cod
Preparation:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Place Cod Fillet in a baking dish.
3. Melt Butter and mix with Lemon Juice, minced Garlic, and chopped Fresh Parsley.
4. Pour the Butter mixture over the Cod Fillet.
5. Sprinkle Black Pepper on top.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes until the Cod Fillet flakes easily with a fork.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Pork Chops with Apple Chutney
Preparation: 1. Season Pork Chop with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
3. Add Pork Chop to the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Remove Pork Chop from skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, melt Butter over medium heat.
6. Add diced Apple and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly soft.
7. Stir in Brown Sugar and Apple Cider Vinegar, cooking for another 2-3 minutes until a chutney consistency forms.
8. Return Pork Chop to the skillet, spoon Apple Chutney over it, and cook for 1-2 minutes to heat through.
9. Serve Pork Chop topped with Apple Chutney.

Name: Spaghetti Bolognese
Preparation: 1. Boil Spaghetti in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add chopped Onion and sauté until translucent.
4. Add Minced Beef to the pan and cook until browned.
5. Stir in Crushed Tomatoes, Paprika, and Black Pepper.
6. Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Serve the sauce over the cooked Spaghetti.
8. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.

Name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Zucchini
Preparation: 1. Peel and devein the Shrimp if not already done.
2. Slice the Zucchini into thin rounds or half-moons.
3. Mince the Garlic finely.
4. Melt Butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
5. Add minced Garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
6. Add Shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and opaque.
7. Toss in the sliced Zucchini and cook for another 2-3 minutes until tender.
8. Sprinkle Red Pepper Flakes over the mixture for a slight kick.
9. Squeeze Lemon juice over the dish and stir to combine.
10. Serve hot and enjoy.

Name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
Preparation:
1. Cut Chicken Breast into thin strips.
2. Slice Bell Pepper and Onion into thin strips.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Chicken Breast strips to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes until browned.
5. Add Bell Pepper and Onion to the pan, stir well.
6. Sprinkle Fajita Spice Mix over the mixture and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Place Cooked Rice in a bowl.
8. Top the Cooked Rice with the cooked Chicken Breast, Bell Pepper, and Onion mixture.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Shepherd's Pie (Beef)
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Boil Potato in water until soft, then mash with Butter and set aside.
3. In a pan, cook Minced Beef over medium heat until browned.
4. Add Carrots & Peas, Tomato Paste, Garlic Powder, and Dried Oregano to the beef, stirring well.
5. Pour in Vegetable Broth, simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
6. Transfer the beef mixture to a baking dish.
7. Spread the mashed Potato evenly over the beef mixture.
8. Bake for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
9. Let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Baked Ziti with Sausage
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cook Ziti Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
3. In a skillet, cook Italian Pork Sausage over medium heat until browned.
4. Add Garlic to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
5. Stir in Marinara Sauce, Dried Basil, and Black Pepper with the sausage, and simmer for 5 minutes.
6. In a baking dish, layer half of the cooked Ziti Pasta, then spread Ricotta Cheese over it.
7. Pour half of the sausage and Marinara Sauce mixture over the Ricotta Cheese.
8. Add the remaining Ziti Pasta and top with the rest of the sauce mixture.
9. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese evenly on top.
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

Name: Pan-Seared Duck Breast
Preparation: 1. Score the skin of the Duck Breast with a sharp knife.
2. Season the Duck Breast with Salt and Black Pepper on both sides.
3. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and place the Duck Breast skin-side down.
4. Cook for 5-7 minutes until the skin is crispy, then flip and cook for another 3-5 minutes.
5. Remove the Duck Breast from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
6. In the same skillet, add Orange Juice and Honey, stirring to combine.
7. Reduce the heat and simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
8. Add Butter to the sauce and stir until melted and glossy.
9. Slice the Duck Breast and drizzle the orange-honey sauce over it before serving.

Name: Creamy Polenta with Mushrooms
Preparation: 1. Bring water to a boil in a pot and slowly whisk in Polenta, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
2. Reduce heat to low and cook Polenta for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally until creamy.
3. Stir in Heavy Cream and Parmesan Cheese into the Polenta until fully combined, then set aside.
4. In a separate pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
5. Add chopped Garlic to the pan and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
6. Add sliced Mushrooms to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes until tender.
7. Season Mushrooms with Dried Oregano and Garlic Powder, stirring well.
8. Serve the creamy Polenta topped with the sautéed Mushrooms.

Name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Portobello
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Clean the Portobello Mushrooms by removing stems and gills.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
5. Add Spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Remove from heat and mix in crumbled Feta Cheese, Breadcrumbs, Paprika, and Dried Basil.
7. Stuff the mixture into the Portobello Mushrooms evenly.
8. Place stuffed mushrooms on a baking sheet.
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
10. Serve warm.

Name: Pasta Primavera (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Boil Penne Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Trim Asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces.
3. Slice Zucchini into thin rounds.
4. Halve Cherry Tomatoes.
5. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
6. Add Asparagus and Zucchini to the pan, sauté for 5 minutes.
7. Add Cherry Tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes.
8. Mix in cooked Penne Pasta, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper.
9. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
10. Sprinkle Parmesan on top before serving.

Name: French Onion Soup
Preparation: 1. Peel and thinly slice 150.0 g of Onion.
2. Melt 10.0 g of Butter in a pot over medium heat.
3. Add sliced Onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally for about 15 minutes.
4. Stir in 1.0 g of Thyme, 1.0 tsp of Dried Basil, and 1.0 tsp of Garlic Powder, and cook for 1 minute.
5. Pour in 200.0 ml of Vegetable Broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Preheat oven broiler.
7. Place 1.0 medium Baguette Slice in an oven-safe bowl, then ladle the soup over the bread.
8. Sprinkle 20.0 g of Gruyere Cheese over the top of the soup and bread.
9. Place the bowl under the broiler until the Gruyere Cheese is melted and bubbly, about 2-3 minutes.
10. Remove from oven and serve hot.

Name: Margarita Risotto
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add Arborio Rice and stir for 1-2 minutes until slightly toasted.
3. Stir in Tomato Puree and cook for 2 minutes.
4. Gradually add Vegetable Broth, stirring constantly until absorbed.
5. Continue adding Vegetable Broth, a little at a time, until Arborio Rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes).
6. Stir in Mozzarella Cheese until melted.
7. Add Dried Oregano and Garlic Powder, mixing well.
8. Remove from heat and garnish with Fresh Basil before serving.

Name: Sweet Potato & Chickpea Curry
Preparation: 1. Peel and dice the Sweet Potato into small cubes.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add diced Sweet Potato and cook for 5-7 minutes until slightly softened.
4. Stir in Curry Powder, Garlic Powder, and Paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add Chickpeas and Coconut Milk, stirring to combine.
6. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until Sweet Potato is tender.
7. Add Spinach and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Ricotta and Spinach Cannelloni
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Cook the Cannelloni Tubes according to package instructions, then drain and set aside.
3. In a bowl, mix Ricotta Cheese, chopped Spinach, Nutmeg, Paprika, and Black Pepper until well combined.
4. Fill the cooked Cannelloni Tubes with the Ricotta and Spinach mixture using a spoon or piping bag.
5. Spread a thin layer of Marinara Sauce in a baking dish.
6. Place the filled Cannelloni Tubes in the dish in a single layer.
7. Pour the remaining Marinara Sauce over the Cannelloni Tubes.
8. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese on top.
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
10. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve.

Name: Lentil Loaf
Preparation: 1. Rinse and cook Brown Lentils in water until tender, then drain.
2. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
3. Finely chop Carrot and Onion.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a pan and sauté chopped Carrot and Onion until soft.
5. In a bowl, mash the cooked Brown Lentils.
6. Add sautéed Carrot and Onion, Oats, Tomato Paste, Black Pepper, and Paprika to the mashed lentils.
7. Mix all ingredients well to form a uniform mixture.
8. Transfer the mixture into a greased loaf pan and press it down evenly.
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes until the top is firm and slightly browned.
10. Let the Lentil Loaf cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: Cheese Fondue with Veggies
Preparation: 1. Grate the Gruyere Cheese and Emmental Cheese into a bowl.
2. Rub the inside of a fondue pot with Garlic.
3. Pour White Wine into the fondue pot and heat over low flame until warm.
4. Gradually add the grated Gruyere Cheese and Emmental Cheese to the pot, stirring continuously until melted and smooth.
5. Stir in Paprika and Black Pepper for flavor.
6. Cut Broccoli into small florets and wash Cherry Tomatoes.
7. Arrange Broccoli and Cherry Tomatoes on a platter for dipping.
8. Serve the melted cheese fondue hot with the veggies for dipping.

Name: Falafel Wrap
Preparation: 1. Soak Chickpeas in water overnight, then drain.
2. Blend Chickpeas with Parsley, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder until a coarse paste forms.
3. Shape the mixture into small balls.
4. Heat Oil in a pan and fry the balls until golden brown.
5. Warm Pita Bread slightly on a pan or in an oven.
6. Spread Tahini inside the Pita Bread.
7. Add fried Chickpea balls and Lettuce inside the Pita Bread.
8. Roll the Pita Bread to form a wrap and serve.

Name: Steak Frites
Preparation: 1. Season the Beef Steak with Paprika and Garlic Powder.
2. Heat Oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
3. Sear the Beef Steak for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, or to desired doneness.
4. Add Butter and Garlic to the pan, baste the steak for 1 minute.
5. Remove steak from pan, top with Herb Butter, and let it rest for 5 minutes.
6. Peel and cut Potato into thin strips for fries.
7. Heat remaining Oil in a separate pan or deep fryer.
8. Fry the Potato strips until golden and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
9. Drain excess oil from fries and season with a pinch of Paprika.
10. Serve the Beef Steak with the crispy Potato fries on the side.

Name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Flatten Chicken Breast using a mallet to an even thickness.
3. Place Ham and Swiss Cheese on the flattened Chicken Breast.
4. Roll the Chicken Breast tightly, securing with toothpicks if needed.
5. Beat the Egg in a bowl.
6. Mix Breadcrumbs with Dried Basil and Dried Oregano in a separate bowl.
7. Dip the rolled Chicken Breast in the Egg, then coat with the Breadcrumb mixture.
8. Heat Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
9. Sear the Chicken Breast on all sides until golden brown.
10. Transfer the Chicken Breast to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes or until fully cooked.

Name: Seared Scallops with Pea Puree
Preparation: 1. Pat the Sea Scallops dry with a paper towel and season with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Sear the Sea Scallops for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown, then set aside.
4. Boil Green Peas in water for 5 minutes until tender, then drain.
5. In a blender, combine Green Peas, Butter, Heavy Cream, and Mint, and blend until smooth to make the puree.
6. Spread the pea puree on a plate as a base.
7. Place the seared Sea Scallops on top of the pea puree.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Sauce
Preparation:
1. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
2. Season Pork Tenderloin with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
3. Sear Pork Tenderloin in the skillet for 3-4 minutes on each side until browned.
4. Remove Pork Tenderloin from skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add minced Garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
6. Pour in Chicken Broth and scrape up any browned bits from the skillet.
7. Stir in Dijon Mustard and Heavy Cream, mixing well.
8. Return Pork Tenderloin to the skillet, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until cooked through.
9. Slice Pork Tenderloin and serve with the Mustard Sauce drizzled over the top.

Name: Clam Linguine
Preparation: 1. Cook Linguine Pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add minced Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
4. Add Clams to the pan and pour in White Wine.
5. Cover the pan and cook until Clams open, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Discard any unopened Clams.
7. Add cooked Linguine Pasta to the pan with Clams.
8. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Paprika over the mixture and toss to combine.
9. Garnish with chopped Parsley before serving.

Name: Lamb Chops with Rosemary
Preparation: 1. Season Lamb Chops with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
3. Add Lamb Chops to the pan and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side.
4. Add Garlic and Rosemary to the pan, then add Butter and baste the Lamb Chops for 1 minute.
5. Remove Lamb Chops from the pan and let them rest for 5 minutes.
6. In the same pan, sauté Asparagus for 3-4 minutes until tender.
7. Serve Lamb Chops with Asparagus on the side.

Name: Chicken Caesar Salad (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Grill the Chicken Breast until fully cooked, then slice into strips.
2. Wash and chop the Romaine Lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
3. In a large bowl, toss the Romaine Lettuce with Caesar Dressing.
4. Add the sliced Chicken Breast on top of the dressed Romaine Lettuce.
5. Sprinkle Croutons and Parmesan Cheese over the salad.
6. Drizzle Olive Oil lightly over the top.
7. Season with Black Pepper and Dried Basil to finish.

Name: Duck Confit
Preparation:
1. Season the Duck Leg with Salt and Thyme.
2. Place the Duck Leg in a pan with Duck Fat.
3. Cook on low heat for 2-3 hours until tender.
4. Boil Potato until soft, then mash or slice.
5. Sauté Garlic in a small amount of Duck Fat.
6. Serve Duck Leg with Potato and Garlic on the side.

Name: Salmon and Quinoa Bowl
Preparation: 1. Rinse Quinoa under cold water and cook in a pot with water until tender, about 15 minutes.
2. Preheat a pan over medium heat and add Olive Oil.
3. Season Salmon with Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano.
4. Place Salmon in the heated pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
5. Steam Broccoli in a separate pot for 5-7 minutes until tender.
6. In a small bowl, mix Lemon juice and Soy Sauce to make a dressing.
7. Assemble the bowl by placing cooked Quinoa as the base, topped with Salmon and Broccoli.
8. Drizzle the Lemon and Soy Sauce dressing over the bowl before serving.

Name: Beef Stroganoff
Preparation: 1. Cook Egg Noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain.
2. Melt Butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
3. Add Onion and sauté until translucent.
4. Add Beef Strips to the skillet and cook until browned.
5. Stir in Mushrooms and cook until softened.
6. Season with Garlic Powder and Black Pepper.
7. Reduce heat, add Sour Cream, and stir until well combined.
8. Serve the Beef Stroganoff over the cooked Egg Noodles.

Name: Eggplant Caviar with Crostini
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C.
2. Slice Eggplant into halves, brush with 5.0 ml Olive Oil, and place on a baking tray.
3. Roast Eggplant for 25-30 minutes until soft, then let it cool.
4. Scoop out the Eggplant flesh and place it in a bowl.
5. Mash Eggplant with a fork, then mix in minced Garlic, Lemon Juice, 5.0 ml Olive Oil, chopped Parsley, Black Pepper, and Dried Oregano.
6. Slice Baguette into thin pieces to make crostini.
7. Brush Baguette Slices with remaining 5.0 ml Olive Oil.
8. Toast Baguette Slices in the oven for 5-7 minutes until golden and crispy.
9. Serve Eggplant mixture on top of Crostini.

Name: Mushroom Wellington
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Finely chop the Mushrooms and Onion.
3. Melt Butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Sauté the chopped Mushrooms and Onion in the Butter for 5-7 minutes until soft.
5. Add Thyme, Dried Oregano, and Black Pepper to the pan, and cook for another 2 minutes.
6. Let the mixture cool slightly.
7. Roll out the Puff Pastry on a lightly floured surface.
8. Place the Mushroom mixture in the center of the Puff Pastry.
9. Fold the Puff Pastry over the filling, sealing the edges tightly.
10. Brush the top with Egg Wash for a golden finish.
11. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the Puff Pastry is golden and crisp.
12. Let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: Caprese Pasta Salad
Preparation: 1. Cook Penne Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain and cool.
2. Halve the Cherry Tomatoes and place them in a large mixing bowl.
3. Add Mozzarella Pearls to the bowl with the tomatoes.
4. Tear Fresh Basil leaves and mix them into the bowl.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil over the mixture and toss gently.
6. Add Balsamic Glaze and sprinkle Paprika and Black Pepper.
7. Mix all ingredients well to combine flavors.
8. Chill in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving.

Name: Spinach & Cheese Quiche
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Place Pie Crust in a pie dish and set aside.
3. In a bowl, whisk together Egg and Heavy Cream.
4. Sauté Spinach in a pan until wilted, then chop finely.
5. Add chopped Spinach, grated Gruyere Cheese, Nutmeg, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper to the egg mixture.
6. Stir well to combine all ingredients.
7. Pour the mixture into the Pie Crust.
8. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the center is set and golden.
9. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Potato Leek Soup
Preparation: 1. Peel and chop Potato into small cubes.
2. Clean and slice Leeks thinly.
3. Melt Butter in a pot over medium heat.
4. Add Leeks to the pot and sauté until soft.
5. Add Potato cubes and stir for 2 minutes.
6. Pour in Vegetable Broth and bring to a boil.
7. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until Potato is tender.
8. Stir in Heavy Cream, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper.
9. Blend the mixture until smooth using a blender or immersion blender.
10. Garnish with chopped Chives before serving.

Name: Greek Spanakopita
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Sauté Onion in Olive Oil until soft.
3. Add Spinach to the pan and cook until wilted.
4. Mix in Feta Cheese, Egg, Garlic Powder, and Dried Oregano.
5. Layer half of the Phyllo Dough in a baking dish, brushing each sheet with Olive Oil.
6. Spread the Spinach mixture over the Phyllo Dough.
7. Cover with the remaining Phyllo Dough, brushing each sheet with Olive Oil.
8. Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden and crisp.
9. Let cool slightly before cutting into pieces.

Name: Beetroot Carpaccio
Preparation: 1. Peel and thinly slice the Beetroot into rounds.
2. Arrange the Beetroot slices on a serving plate.
3. Crumble the Goat Cheese over the Beetroot slices.
4. Sprinkle Walnuts and Arugula on top.
5. In a small bowl, mix Olive Oil, Lemon Juice, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder.
6. Drizzle the dressing over the Beetroot and toppings.
7. Serve immediately.

Name: Zucchini Fritters
Preparation: 1. Grate Zucchini and squeeze out excess moisture using a clean cloth.
2. In a bowl, mix grated Zucchini, Flour, Egg, crumbled Feta Cheese, Dill, Dried Oregano, and Dried Basil until well combined.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Scoop spoonfuls of the mixture into the pan, flattening them into fritters.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
6. Remove from pan and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
7. Serve warm.

Name: Tomato Galette
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Roll out the Pie Crust on a baking sheet.
3. Spread Ricotta Cheese evenly over the Pie Crust, leaving a border around the edges.
4. Slice the Tomato and arrange the slices over the Ricotta Cheese.
5. Sprinkle Parmesan, Thyme, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil over the Tomato slices.
6. Drizzle Olive Oil on top.
7. Fold the edges of the Pie Crust over the filling, creating a rustic border.
8. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
9. Let the Tomato Galette cool slightly before serving.

Name: Cauliflower Steaks
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Cut the Cauliflower into thick slices (about 1.5-2 inches) to form steaks.
3. In a small bowl, mix Olive Oil, Garlic Powder, and Paprika to create a marinade.
4. Brush the marinade evenly on both sides of the Cauliflower steaks.
5. Place the Cauliflower steaks on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender.
7. Drizzle Lemon juice over the baked Cauliflower steaks.
8. Garnish with chopped Parsley before serving.

Name: Butternut Squash Ravioli
Preparation: 1. Cook Ravioli in boiling water until tender, then drain.
2. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
3. Add Sage Leaves to the Butter and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
4. Mix in Butternut Squash, mashing it slightly, and cook for 3-4 minutes.
5. Season with Nutmeg, Dried Oregano, and Black Pepper, stirring well.
6. Add cooked Ravioli to the pan and toss to coat evenly.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.

Name: Stuffed Eggplant (Imam Bayildi)
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Cut Eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the center to create a shell.
3. Chop the scooped-out Eggplant flesh finely.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Sauté Onion and Garlic until soft and golden.
6. Add chopped Eggplant flesh and Tomato to the pan, cook for 5 minutes.
7. Stir in Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano, cook for another 2 minutes.
8. Remove from heat and mix in chopped Parsley.
9. Stuff the Eggplant shells with the mixture.
10. Place stuffed Eggplant in a baking dish and drizzle with remaining Olive Oil.
11. Bake for 30-35 minutes until Eggplant is tender.
12. Serve warm or at room temperature.

Name: Vegetarian Cassoulet
Preparation: 1. Rinse and drain the Cannellini Beans.
2. Chop the Carrot & Celery into small pieces.
3. Heat Olive Oil in a large pot over medium heat.
