4. Add Carrot & Celery to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes.
5. Stir in Tomato Paste, Dried Basil, and Paprika, cooking for 2 minutes.
6. Pour in Vegetable Broth and add Cannellini Beans, stirring well.
7. Simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
8. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
9. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle Breadcrumbs on top.
10. Bake for 15 minutes until the top is golden and crispy.

Name: Broccoli Pesto Pasta
Preparation:
1. Boil Penne Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Steam Broccoli until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
3. In a blender, combine steamed Broccoli, Fresh Basil, Walnuts, Olive Oil, Parmesan, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil.
4. Blend until a smooth pesto sauce forms.
5. Toss the cooked Penne Pasta with the Broccoli pesto sauce.
6. Serve warm, garnished with extra Parmesan if desired.

Name: Celeriac Steak
Preparation: 1. Peel and slice the Celeriac into thick steaks, about 1 inch thick.
2. Heat Butter in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add Celeriac steaks to the pan and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Pour Vegetable Broth into the pan to partially cover the steaks.
5. Add Thyme, minced Garlic, and Black Pepper to the broth.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until Celeriac is tender.
7. Remove from heat and serve hot.

Name: Coq Au Vin
Preparation:
1. Cut Chicken into pieces and season with Garlic Powder and Paprika.
2. Cook Bacon in a pan until crispy, then remove and set aside.
3. In the same pan, add Butter and brown the Chicken pieces on all sides.
4. Add Mushrooms and Pearl Onions, cooking until slightly softened.
5. Pour in Red Wine, bring to a simmer, and return Bacon to the pan.
6. Cover and cook on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Serve hot with the sauce from the pan.

Name: Prawn Linguine
Preparation: 1. Boil water in a large pot, add Linguine Pasta, and cook until al dente, then drain.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add minced Garlic and Red Chili Flakes to the pan, sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add Prawns to the pan, cook for 3-4 minutes until pink and cooked through.
5. Season with Black Pepper and Dried Oregano, stirring well.
6. Toss the cooked Linguine Pasta into the pan with the prawns, mixing to coat evenly.
7. Sprinkle chopped Parsley over the dish, stir, and serve immediately.

Name: Beef Bourguignon
Preparation: 1. Cut Beef Chuck into bite-sized cubes.
2. Peel and slice Carrot into rounds.
3. In a pot, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Add Beef Chuck cubes and brown on all sides.
5. Sprinkle Flour over the beef and stir to coat.
6. Pour in Red Wine and Beef Broth, stirring to combine.
7. Add sliced Carrot, Paprika, and Dried Oregano to the pot.
8. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2-3 hours until beef is tender.
9. Stir occasionally and adjust seasoning if needed.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Piccata
Preparation: 1. Season Chicken Breast with Black Pepper and Paprika.
2. Dredge Chicken Breast in Flour, shaking off excess.
3. Heat Olive Oil and Butter in a skillet over medium heat.
4. Cook Chicken Breast in the skillet for 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
5. Remove Chicken Breast from skillet and set aside.
6. Add Lemon Juice and Capers to the skillet, stirring to combine.
7. Return Chicken Breast to the skillet, coating it in the sauce.
8. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until Chicken Breast is fully cooked.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Nicoise Salad
Preparation: 1. Boil the Egg for 10 minutes, then cool and peel it.
2. Boil the Potato until tender, about 15 minutes, then cut into small chunks.
3. Blanch the Green Beans in boiling water for 3 minutes, then cool in ice water.
4. Drain the Canned Tuna and flake it into a bowl.
5. In a large serving bowl, combine the Canned Tuna, Egg (quartered), Potato, Green Beans, and Kalamata Olives.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together Olive Oil, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder to make a dressing.
7. Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Pork Belly Bao
Preparation: 1. Slice the Pork Belly into thin strips.
2. Season the Pork Belly with Sugar, Garlic Powder, and Dried Basil.
3. Cook the seasoned Pork Belly in a pan over medium heat until crispy, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Steam the Bao Bun for 5-7 minutes until soft and fluffy.
5. Slice the Cucumber and Spring Onion into thin strips.
6. Spread Hoisin Sauce inside the steamed Bao Bun.
7. Add the cooked Pork Belly, Cucumber, and Spring Onion into the Bao Bun.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Lamb Shank with Mash
Preparation: 1. Season the Lamb Shank with Paprika and Black Pepper.
2. Sear the Lamb Shank in a hot pan until browned on all sides.
3. Place the seared Lamb Shank in a pot with Beef Broth and Rosemary.
4. Add chopped Carrot to the pot.
5. Simmer on low heat for 2-3 hours until the Lamb Shank is tender.
6. Meanwhile, boil Potato in water until soft.
7. Mash the Potato with Butter until smooth.
8. Serve the Lamb Shank with the mashed Potato on the side.

Name: Fish and Chips
Preparation: 1. Peel and cut Potato into thick strips for chips.
2. Heat Oil in a deep fryer or large pan to 180°C.
3. Fry Potato strips in hot Oil until golden and crispy, then drain.
4. In a bowl, mix Flour, Beer, Paprika, and Dried Oregano to make batter.
5. Coat Cod Fillet in the batter evenly.
6. Fry battered Cod Fillet in hot Oil until golden and cooked through, about 4-5 minutes.
7. Drain excess Oil from Cod Fillet on paper towels.
8. Serve Cod Fillet and Potato chips with Tartar Sauce on the side.

Name: Chicken Milanese
Preparation: 1. Flatten Chicken Breast to an even thickness using a mallet.
2. Season Chicken Breast with Dried Oregano and Paprika.
3. Beat the Egg in a shallow bowl.
4. Spread Breadcrumbs on a plate.
5. Dip Chicken Breast in Egg, then coat with Breadcrumbs.
6. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
7. Cook Chicken Breast in the skillet for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
8. Place cooked Chicken Breast on a plate and top with Arugula.
9. Drizzle Lemon over the Chicken Breast and Arugula before serving.

Name: Swedish Meatballs
Preparation: 1. In a bowl, mix Minced Beef/Pork Mix with Breadcrumbs, Heavy Cream, Garlic Powder, and Dried Oregano until well combined.
2. Shape the mixture into small, round meatballs.
3. Heat Butter in a skillet over medium heat.
4. Add meatballs to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 8-10 minutes.
5. Pour Beef Broth into the skillet, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Serve the meatballs hot, with Lingonberry Jam on the side.

Name: Duck Liver Pate with Toast
Preparation: 1. Clean and trim the Duck Liver (60.0 g), removing any sinew or impurities.
2. Finely chop the Shallots (10.0 g).
3. Melt Butter (20.0 g) in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Shallots to the pan and sauté until soft.
5. Add Duck Liver to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes until browned.
6. Pour in Brandy (5.0 ml) and cook for another 1-2 minutes to deglaze the pan.
7. Season with Thyme (1.0 g), Black Pepper (1.0 tsp), and Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp).
8. Transfer the mixture to a blender and process until smooth to form a pate.
9. Slice the Baguette (2.0 medium) into thin pieces.
10. Toast the Baguette slices until golden and crisp.
11. Spread the Duck Liver pate on the toasted Baguette slices and serve.

Name: Spanish Paella
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Chorizo and cook until browned, then remove and set aside.
3. In the same pan, cook Prawns until pink, then remove and set aside.
4. Pour Chicken Broth into the pan and bring to a simmer.
5. Add Saffron to the broth and stir to dissolve.
6. Stir in Bomba Rice, ensuring it is evenly coated with the broth.
7. Sprinkle Dried Basil and Black Pepper over the rice mixture.
8. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes until rice is tender.
9. Return Chorizo and Prawns to the pan, mix well, and heat through for 2-3 minutes.
10. Serve hot directly from the pan.

Name: Beef Tartare
Preparation: 1. Finely chop the Beef Tenderloin into small pieces and place in a bowl.
2. Add the Egg Yolk to the chopped Beef Tenderloin.
3. Mix in the Capers, Dijon Mustard, and finely chopped Shallots.
4. Drizzle the Olive Oil over the mixture and stir well.
5. Season with Paprika and Black Pepper, mixing thoroughly to combine.
6. Shape the mixture into a small mound or patty on a serving plate.
7. Serve immediately, chilled if preferred.

Name: Croque Monsieur
Preparation: 1. Melt Butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add Flour to the melted Butter and stir to form a roux.
3. Gradually whisk in Milk to the roux, stirring constantly until thickened into a béchamel sauce.
4. Season the béchamel sauce with Paprika and Dried Oregano, then set aside.
5. Preheat a grill or broiler to medium-high heat.
6. Place Ham and half of the Gruyere Cheese between two slices of White Bread to form a sandwich.
7. Spread a layer of the béchamel sauce on top of the sandwich.
8. Sprinkle the remaining Gruyere Cheese over the béchamel sauce.
9. Place the sandwich under the grill or broiler until the cheese is melted and golden brown.
10. Serve hot and enjoy.

Name: Trout Almondine
Preparation: 1. Pat the Trout dry with paper towels.
2. Lightly coat the Trout with Flour on both sides.
3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and melt half of the Butter.
4. Place the Trout in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden.
5. Remove the Trout from the skillet and set aside.
6. In the same skillet, add the remaining Butter and Sliced Almonds, cooking until almonds are lightly toasted.
7. Stir in Lemon Juice, Parsley, Garlic Powder, and Dried Oregano, mixing well.
8. Pour the almond sauce over the Trout and serve immediately.

Name: Creamy Mushroom Pappardelle
Preparation: 1. Cook Pappardelle Pasta in boiling salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Slice Mushrooms thinly.
3. Mince Garlic finely.
4. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
5. Add minced Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
6. Add sliced Mushrooms and cook until they release their juices and soften.
7. Stir in Garlic Powder and Paprika, mixing well.
8. Pour in Heavy Cream and stir to combine, letting it simmer for 2-3 minutes.
9. Add grated Parmesan Cheese, stirring until melted and the sauce thickens.
10. Toss the cooked Pappardelle Pasta in the creamy mushroom sauce until well coated.
11. Serve hot.

Name: Veggie Shepherd's Pie
Preparation: 1. Rinse and cook Brown Lentils in water until tender, then drain.
2. Peel and boil Potato until soft, then mash with Butter.
3. Peel and chop Carrot into small pieces.
4. In a pan, combine cooked Brown Lentils, chopped Carrot, Vegetable Broth, Thyme, Dried Oregano, and Dried Basil.
5. Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes until Carrot is tender.
6. Transfer the lentil mixture to a baking dish.
7. Spread the mashed Potato over the lentil mixture evenly.
8. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until the top is golden.

Name: Eggplant Parmigiana
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice Eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
3. Coat Eggplant slices with Breadcrumbs.
4. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Fry Eggplant slices until golden brown on both sides.
6. Spread a layer of Marinara Sauce in a baking dish.
7. Place fried Eggplant slices over the Marinara Sauce.
8. Sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese and Parmesan Cheese over Eggplant.
9. Add Dried Basil and Garlic Powder on top.
10. Repeat layers with remaining Eggplant, Marinara Sauce, and cheeses.
11. Bake for 20-25 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
12. Let cool slightly before serving.

Name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
Preparation: 1. Rinse and cook Quinoa in water according to package instructions, then let it cool.
2. Dice Cucumber into small pieces.
3. Halve Cherry Tomatoes.
4. Pit and chop Kalamata Olives if needed.
5. Crumble Feta Cheese into small bits.
6. In a large bowl, combine cooled Quinoa, Cucumber, Cherry Tomatoes, Kalamata Olives, and Feta Cheese.
7. Drizzle Olive Oil over the mixture.
8. Sprinkle Dried Basil and Garlic Powder on top.
9. Toss everything together until well mixed.
10. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Name: French Onion Tart
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Thinly slice the Onion.
3. Melt Butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add sliced Onion to the pan and cook until caramelized, about 15 minutes.
5. Season the Onion with Thyme, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper.
6. Roll out the Puff Pastry on a baking sheet.
7. Spread the caramelized Onion mixture evenly over the Puff Pastry.
8. Grate Gruyere Cheese and sprinkle it over the Onion layer.
9. Beat the Egg and brush it lightly over the edges of the Puff Pastry.
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the pastry is golden and crisp.
11. Let it cool slightly before slicing and serving.

Name: Cacio e Pepe
Preparation: 1. Boil Spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserving 30.0 ml of Pasta Water before draining.
2. In a pan, heat Olive Oil and Butter over medium heat.
3. Add Black Pepper to the pan and toast for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
4. Add the reserved Pasta Water to the pan and stir to combine.
5. Toss the cooked Spaghetti in the pan to coat with the sauce.
6. Remove from heat and gradually mix in Pecorino Romano until melted and creamy.
7. Serve immediately.

Name: Ratatouille (Traditional)
Preparation: 1. Dice the Eggplant, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, and Tomato into small, even pieces.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add Eggplant and Zucchini to the pan, cooking for 5-7 minutes until slightly softened.
4. Stir in Bell Pepper and Tomato, mixing well.
5. Sprinkle Herbes de Provence over the mixture and stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender.
7. Serve hot as a main course or side dish.

Name: Butternut Squash Soup
Preparation: 1. Peel and cube the Butternut Squash (200.0 g).
2. Chop the Onion (30.0 g) finely.
3. Melt Butter (10.0 g) in a pot over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Onion to the pot and sauté until soft.
5. Add cubed Butternut Squash and stir for 2 minutes.
6. Pour in Vegetable Broth (150.0 ml) and bring to a boil.
7. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until squash is tender.
8. Add Nutmeg (1.0 g), Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp), and Dried Basil (1.0 tsp).
9. Blend the mixture until smooth using a blender or immersion blender.
10. Stir in Heavy Cream (15.0 ml) and heat through for 2 minutes.
11. Serve warm.

Name: Mushroom Risotto (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
3. Add Mushrooms and cook until softened.
4. Stir in Arborio Rice and coat it with the oil.
5. Gradually add Vegetable Broth, stirring constantly until absorbed.
6. Continue adding broth and stirring until Rice is creamy and tender.
7. Season with Black Pepper and Garlic Powder.
8. Stir in Parmesan Cheese until melted and well combined.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Caprese Zucchini Boats
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice Zucchini in half lengthwise and scoop out the center to create boats.
3. Brush Zucchini boats with Olive Oil.
4. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Dried Basil over the Zucchini.
5. Cut Cherry Tomatoes in half and place them inside the Zucchini boats.
6. Slice Mozzarella Cheese and lay pieces on top of the Cherry Tomatoes.
7. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes until Zucchini is tender and cheese is melted.
8. Drizzle Balsamic Glaze over the boats.
9. Garnish with Fresh Basil before serving.

Name: Spinach & Ricotta Ravioli
Preparation:
1. Boil water in a pot and cook Ravioli for 5-7 minutes until tender.
2. Drain the Ravioli and set aside.
3. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Add Marinara Sauce to the pan and stir well.
5. Season the sauce with Paprika and Black Pepper.
6. Add the cooked Ravioli to the sauce and mix gently to coat.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan Cheese on top before serving.

Name: Stuffed Bell Peppers (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cut the top off the Bell Pepper and remove seeds.
3. Cook Quinoa according to package instructions.
4. Mix cooked Quinoa, Black Beans, and Corn in a bowl.
5. Stuff the Bell Pepper with the Quinoa mixture.
6. Top with Cheddar Cheese.
7. Place stuffed Bell Pepper in a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes.
8. Remove from oven and top with Salsa before serving.

Name: Asparagus and Goat Cheese Tart
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Roll out the Puff Pastry on a baking sheet.
3. Trim the Asparagus and arrange it evenly over the Puff Pastry.
4. Crumble the Goat Cheese over the Asparagus.
5. Drizzle Olive Oil over the tart.
6. Sprinkle Thyme, Dried Basil, and Dried Oregano on top.
7. Brush the edges of the Puff Pastry with Egg Wash.
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes until the pastry is golden and crisp.
9. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve.

Name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta (Meal Size)
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice the Baguette into 1-inch thick pieces.
3. Brush each slice with Olive Oil and place on a baking sheet.
4. Bake Baguette slices for 5-7 minutes until lightly toasted.
5. Dice the Tomato into small pieces and place in a bowl.
6. Mince the Garlic and add to the Tomato.
7. Chop the Fresh Basil finely and mix with the Tomato and Garlic.
8. Add Balsamic Vinegar, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper to the mixture.
9. Drizzle remaining Olive Oil over the mixture and stir well.
10. Spoon the Tomato mixture onto each toasted Baguette slice.
11. Serve immediately.

Name: Cauliflower Cheese
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Cut the Cauliflower into florets and boil in water for 5-7 minutes until tender, then drain.
3. In a saucepan, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Stir in Flour to form a paste, cooking for 1 minute.
5. Gradually whisk in Milk to create a smooth sauce, stirring constantly until it thickens.
6. Add Mustard Powder, Black Pepper, and Garlic Powder to the sauce, mixing well.
7. Stir in grated Cheddar Cheese until fully melted and combined.
8. Place the cooked Cauliflower in an ovenproof dish and pour the cheese sauce over it.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes until golden and bubbly.
10. Remove from the oven and serve hot.

Name: Chicken Alfredo
Preparation: 1. Cook Fettuccine Pasta in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
2. Cut Chicken Breast into small pieces and season with Garlic Powder.
3. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Add minced Garlic to the pan and sauté for 1 minute.
5. Add Chicken Breast pieces to the pan and cook until fully done.
6. Pour Heavy Cream into the pan and stir well.
7. Add Parmesan Cheese and stir until it melts into a creamy sauce.
8. Sprinkle Dried Oregano into the sauce and mix.
9. Toss the cooked Fettuccine Pasta in the sauce until well coated.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Steak Tartare
Preparation: 1. Finely chop the Beef Tenderloin into small pieces and place in a bowl.
2. Add Egg Yolk, Capers, and finely diced Shallots to the beef.
3. Drizzle Olive Oil over the mixture and stir to combine.
4. Season with Garlic Powder and Black Pepper, mixing well.
5. Toast the slice of Toast until golden and crispy.
6. Serve the Steak Tartare mixture on or alongside the Toast.

Name: Lemon Garlic Butter Salmon
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Place Salmon and Asparagus on a baking tray.
3. Drizzle Olive Oil over Salmon and Asparagus.
4. Melt Butter in a small bowl and mix with Lemon Juice, minced Garlic, Garlic Powder, and Dried Basil.
5. Pour the Butter mixture over the Salmon and Asparagus.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes until Salmon is cooked through and Asparagus is tender.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Pork Snitzel
Preparation: 1. Tenderize the Pork Loin by pounding it to an even thickness.
2. Season the Pork Loin with Black Pepper and Garlic Powder on both sides.
3. Set up three shallow dishes: one with Flour, one with beaten Egg, and one with Breadcrumbs.
4. Dredge the Pork Loin first in Flour, then dip in Egg, and finally coat with Breadcrumbs.
5. Heat Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Fry the coated Pork Loin in the hot Oil for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through.
7. Remove from skillet and place on a paper towel to drain excess Oil.
8. Serve hot with a squeeze of Lemon on top.

Name: Chicken Cacciatore
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add Chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
3. Remove Chicken and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add Onion and Bell Pepper, and sauté until softened.
5. Stir in Crushed Tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
6. Return Chicken to the skillet, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes until fully cooked.
7. Add Kalamata Olives and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Beef Wellington
Preparation: 1. Season the Beef Tenderloin with Black Pepper and Dried Oregano.
2. Sear the Beef Tenderloin in a hot pan until browned on all sides, then set aside to cool.
3. Finely chop the Mushrooms and cook them in a pan until moisture evaporates, then let cool.
4. Brush the cooled Beef Tenderloin with Mustard.
5. Lay out Prosciutto slices on a flat surface, overlapping slightly.
6. Spread the cooked Mushrooms over the Prosciutto.
7. Place the Beef Tenderloin on top of the Mushroom layer and wrap tightly with Prosciutto.
8. Roll out the Puff Pastry and wrap it around the Beef Tenderloin, sealing the edges.
9. Brush the Puff Pastry with Egg Wash for a golden finish.
10. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 25-30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
11. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

Name: Seafood Paella
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Tomato, chopped, and cook until soft.
3. Stir in Bomba Rice, ensuring it is coated with oil.
4. Add Saffron, Paprika, and Black Pepper, mixing well.
5. Pour in Chicken Broth and bring to a simmer.
6. Add Mixed Seafood, spreading it evenly over the rice.
7. Cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes without stirring, until rice is tender and seafood is cooked.
8. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Duck a l'Orange
Preparation: 1. Score the skin of the Duck Breast lightly with a sharp knife.
2. Heat Duck Fat in a pan over medium heat.
3. Place Duck Breast skin-side down in the pan and cook for 6-8 minutes until skin is crispy.
4. Flip Duck Breast and cook for another 3-4 minutes, then remove from pan and let it rest.
5. In the same pan, add Orange Juice, Sugar, and Vinegar, stirring to combine.
6. Simmer the mixture for 3-5 minutes until it thickens slightly into a sauce.
7. Stir in Butter until melted and fully incorporated into the sauce.
8. Add Dried Basil and Garlic Powder to the sauce, mixing well.
9. Slice the rested Duck Breast and drizzle the orange sauce over it before serving.

Name: Spaghetti Carbonara
Preparation: 1. Boil Spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserving 30.0 ml of Pasta Water before draining.
2. Cut Guanciale/Pancetta into small pieces and cook in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
3. In a bowl, whisk Egg Yolks with grated Pecorino Romano and Black Pepper until combined.
4. Add the reserved Pasta Water to the Egg Yolks mixture and stir to create a creamy sauce.
5. Toss the cooked Spaghetti with the crispy Guanciale/Pancetta in the pan.
6. Remove the pan from heat and quickly mix in the Egg Yolks sauce, stirring to coat the Spaghetti evenly.
7. Serve immediately with an extra sprinkle of Pecorino Romano and Black Pepper if desired.

Name: Chicken Cordon Bleu (Dinner Special)
Preparation:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Pound Chicken Breast to flatten evenly.
3. Place Swiss Cheese and Ham on flattened Chicken Breast.
4. Roll up Chicken Breast tightly, securing with toothpicks if needed.
5. Beat Egg in a bowl.
6. Mix Breadcrumbs, Black Pepper, and Paprika in a separate bowl.
7. Dip rolled Chicken Breast in Egg, then coat with Breadcrumb mixture.
8. Heat Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
9. Sear Chicken Breast on all sides until golden brown.
10. Transfer Chicken Breast to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes or until cooked through.
11. Remove from oven, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve.

Name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
Preparation: 1. Boil the Egg in water for 10 minutes, then cool and peel.
2. Boil the Potato in water until tender, about 15 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
3. Trim and boil the Green Beans in water for 5 minutes, then drain and cool.
4. Drain the Canned Tuna and flake it into a large bowl.
5. Add the boiled Potato, Green Beans, and Kalamata Olives to the bowl with the Tuna.
6. Slice the boiled Egg and arrange on top of the salad.
7. Drizzle the Olive Oil Dressing over the salad.
8. Sprinkle Black Pepper and Garlic Powder evenly over the top.
9. Toss gently to combine all ingredients before serving.

Name: Lamb Moussaka
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Slice the Eggplant into thin rounds and brush with Olive Oil.
3. Grill or bake the Eggplant slices for 5-7 minutes until tender.
4. In a pan, cook the Minced Lamb over medium heat until browned.
5. Add Tomato Sauce, Cinnamon, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil to the lamb, and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. In a baking dish, layer half of the Eggplant slices at the bottom.
7. Spread the lamb mixture over the Eggplant layer.
8. Add the remaining Eggplant slices on top of the lamb mixture.
9. Pour Bechamel Sauce evenly over the top layer.
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes until golden and bubbly.
11. Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
Preparation: 1. Season Chicken Breast with Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
3. Add seasoned Chicken Breast to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.
4. Remove Chicken Breast from skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add minced Garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
6. Add Sun-dried Tomatoes and Spinach, cooking for 2-3 minutes until Spinach wilts.
7. Pour in Heavy Cream, stirring to combine all ingredients.
8. Return Chicken Breast to the skillet, coating it in the creamy sauce.
9. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Bouillabaisse
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large pot over medium heat.
2. Add chopped Tomato and sliced Fennel Bulb, sauté for 5 minutes.
3. Stir in Garlic Powder and Black Pepper, cook for 1 minute.
4. Pour in Fish Broth and add Saffron, bring to a simmer.
5. Add Mixed Seafood, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes until seafood is cooked through.
6. Serve hot in bowls.

Name: Pork Belly with Apples
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Season Pork Belly with Salt on all sides.
3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add Butter.
4. Sear Pork Belly in the skillet until golden brown on all sides.
5. Slice Apple into thin wedges.
6. Place seared Pork Belly in a baking dish and arrange Apple wedges around it.
7. Drizzle Apple Cider Vinegar over the Pork Belly and Apples.
8. Sprinkle Thyme over the top.
9. Bake in the oven for 1.5 hours or until Pork Belly is tender.
10. Serve hot, ensuring Apples are soft and caramelized.

Name: Truffle Mac and Cheese
Preparation: 1. Boil Macaroni Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. In a saucepan, heat Heavy Cream over medium heat.
3. Add Gruyere Cheese and Cheddar Cheese to the cream, stirring until melted.
4. Stir in Truffle Oil, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper to the cheese sauce.
5. Mix the cooked Macaroni Pasta with the cheese sauce until well coated.
6. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle Breadcrumbs on top.
7. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 10-15 minutes until the top is golden and crispy.

Name: Vegetable Paella (Vegan)
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add Bell Pepper and Artichoke Hearts, sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
3. Stir in Bomba Rice and cook for 2 minutes to coat with oil.
4. Add Saffron to Vegetable Broth, then pour the broth into the pan.
5. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes without stirring.
6. Remove from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
Preparation: 1. Boil Potato Gnocchi in salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
2. In a pan, heat Olive Oil over medium heat.
3. Add Marinara Sauce to the pan and stir in Garlic Powder and Dried Oregano.
4. Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add the cooked Potato Gnocchi to the sauce and mix gently to coat.
6. Transfer the gnocchi and sauce mixture to a baking dish.
7. Top with Mozzarella Cheese and Parmesan.
8. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
9. Garnish with Fresh Basil before serving.

Name: Mushroom Stroganoff (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Cook Egg Noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain.
2. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
3. Add Mushrooms to the pan and sauté until soft and browned.
4. Stir in Paprika & Dijon, mixing well with the Mushrooms.
5. Pour in Vegetable Broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Reduce heat, add Sour Cream, and stir until creamy.
7. Combine the sauce with cooked Egg Noodles and serve hot.

Name: Creamed Spinach with Garlic Toast
Preparation: 1. Wash and chop Spinach (250.0 g) finely.
2. Melt Butter (10.0 g) in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add chopped Spinach to the pan and sauté until wilted.
4. Stir in Heavy Cream (40.0 ml) and Cream Cheese (20.0 g) until smooth.
5. Season with Nutmeg (1.0 g), Paprika (1.0 tsp), and Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp).
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the mixture thickens.
7. Toast Garlic Toast (2.0 medium) until golden and crispy.
8. Serve creamed Spinach hot with Garlic Toast on the side.

Name: Fondue (Single Serving)
Preparation: 1. Grate 60.0 g of Gruyere/Emmental Blend and set aside.
2. Rub a pot with 3.0 g of Garlic to infuse flavor.
3. Pour 30.0 ml of White Wine into the pot and heat over low flame.
4. Gradually add the grated Gruyere/Emmental Blend, stirring until melted.
5. Mix 3.0 g of Cornstarch with a little water to form a slurry, then stir into the cheese mixture to thicken.
6. Season with 1.0 g of Nutmeg, 1.0 tsp of Dried Oregano, and 1.0 tsp of Garlic Powder.
7. Cut 50.0 g of Baguette into bite-sized cubes.
8. Transfer the cheese mixture to a fondue pot and keep warm.
9. Serve with Baguette cubes for dipping.

Name: Coq Au Riesling
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken Breast into bite-sized pieces.
2. Dice Bacon into small strips.
3. Slice Mushrooms thinly.
4. Heat Butter in a large pan over medium heat.
5. Add Bacon to the pan and cook until crispy.
6. Add Chicken Breast pieces to the pan and cook until golden brown.
7. Stir in Mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened.
8. Pour Riesling Wine into the pan and let it simmer for 5 minutes.
9. Add Heavy Cream, Black Pepper, and Dried Oregano, stirring well.
10. Reduce heat and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
11. Serve hot.

Name: Pork Chops with Mustard Sauce
Preparation: 1. Season the Pork Chop with Garlic Powder on both sides.
2. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add Butter.
3. Sear the Pork Chop in the skillet for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
4. Remove the Pork Chop from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add Chicken Broth and scrape up any browned bits.
6. Stir in Whole Grain Mustard and Heavy Cream, mixing well.
7. Add Thyme and Dried Basil, then simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes until thickened.
8. Return the Pork Chop to the skillet, coating it in the sauce.
9. Cook for an additional 2 minutes to heat through.
10. Serve the Pork Chop with the Mustard Sauce drizzled on top.

Name: Classic French Omelette
Preparation: 1. Crack 3 large Eggs into a bowl and whisk until well combined.
2. Season the Eggs with 1 g of Salt and 1 g of White Pepper.
3. Finely chop 3 g of Chives and set aside.
4. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and melt 15 g of Butter.
5. Pour the whisked Eggs into the pan and stir gently with a spatula.
6. As the Eggs start to set, sprinkle 10 g of grated Gruyere Cheese and the chopped Chives over one half.
7. Fold the omelette in half over the filling and cook for another 30 seconds.
8. Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve immediately.

Name: Salisbury Steak
Preparation:
1. In a bowl, mix Minced Beef with Breadcrumbs, Garlic Powder, and Dried Basil.
2. Shape the mixture into patties.
3. In a pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Onion and Mushrooms to the pan, sauté until soft.
5. Remove vegetables, then cook patties in the same pan until browned on both sides.
6. Return Onion and Mushrooms to the pan with the patties.
7. Pour Beef Broth over the mixture, simmer for 10 minutes until patties are cooked through.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Kyiv
Preparation: 1. Cut a pocket into the side of the Chicken Breast without piercing through.
2. Stuff the pocket with Compound Butter and seal the opening with toothpicks if needed.
3. Season the Chicken Breast with Black Pepper and Dried Oregano.
4. Coat the Chicken Breast lightly with Flour.
5. Dip the floured Chicken Breast into a beaten Egg, ensuring full coverage.
6. Roll the Chicken Breast in Breadcrumbs to coat evenly.
7. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
8. Fry the Chicken Breast in the hot Oil for 5-7 minutes on each side until golden brown.
9. Transfer to an oven preheated at 180°C (350°F) and bake for 15-20 minutes until fully cooked.
10. Remove toothpicks if used, and serve hot.

Name: Mushroom Bouguignon
Preparation: 1. Clean and slice the Mixed Mushrooms into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a large pan, melt Butter over medium heat.
3. Add Pearl Onions to the pan and sauté until golden.
4. Add Mixed Mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their juices.
5. Stir in Thyme, Black Pepper, and Paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
6. Pour in Red Wine and Vegetable Broth, stirring to combine.
7. Simmer the mixture on low heat for 20-25 minutes until the sauce thickens.
8. Adjust seasoning with additional Black Pepper if needed.
9. Serve hot as a main course.

Name: Eggplant Rollatini
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice Eggplant lengthwise into thin strips (about 150.0 g total).
3. Brush Eggplant slices with Olive Oil (10.0 ml) on both sides.
4. Grill or bake Eggplant slices for 3-4 minutes per side until tender.
5. In a bowl, mix Ricotta Cheese (40.0 g), Spinach (20.0 g), Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp), and Paprika (1.0 tsp).
6. Spread the Ricotta mixture onto each Eggplant slice and roll up tightly.
7. Place rolls in a baking dish and top with Marinara Sauce (80.0 g).
8. Sprinkle Mozzarella (10.0 g) over the top.
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Polenta with Roasted Vegetables
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
2. Toss Mixed Vegetables with Olive Oil, Paprika, and Dried Basil.
3. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 25-30 minutes until tender.
4. In a saucepan, cook Polenta according to package instructions.
5. Stir Butter and Parmesan into the cooked Polenta until melted and creamy.
6. Serve the Polenta on a plate, topped with roasted Mixed Vegetables.
7. Drizzle Balsamic Glaze over the top before serving.

Name: Vegetarian Cassoulet (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Rinse and drain the Cannellini Beans.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pot over medium heat.
3. Add Carrot & Celery, and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
4. Stir in Tomato Paste, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper, and cook for 2 minutes.
5. Pour in Vegetable Broth and add the Cannellini Beans, stirring well.
6. Simmer the mixture for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
8. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle Breadcrumbs evenly on top.
9. Bake for 15 minutes or until the Breadcrumbs are golden and crispy.
10. Remove from the oven and serve hot.

Name: Broccoli and Cheddar Soup
Preparation: 1. Chop Broccoli into small florets.
2. Melt Butter in a pot over medium heat.
3. Add Flour to the pot and stir to form a roux.
4. Gradually pour in Vegetable Broth while stirring to avoid lumps.
5. Add Broccoli florets to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Stir in Heavy Cream and shredded Cheddar Cheese until melted.
7. Season with Dried Oregano and Paprika, and stir well.
8. Cook for another 5 minutes until the soup thickens.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Asparagus Risotto
Preparation: 1. Finely chop the Onion.
2. Trim and cut Asparagus into bite-sized pieces.
3. Heat Butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Onion to the pan and sauté until translucent.
5. Stir in Arborio Rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly toasted.
6. Gradually add Vegetable/White Wine Broth, stirring constantly, allowing the rice to absorb the liquid before adding more.
7. When the rice is halfway cooked, add Asparagus pieces and continue stirring.
8. Once the rice is creamy and tender, stir in Parmesan, Black Pepper, and Dried Basil.
9. Serve hot.

Name: Steak Frites (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Season Beef Sirloin with Garlic Powder and Paprika.
2. Heat Oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
3. Sear Beef Sirloin for 3-4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, then set aside to rest.
4. Cut Potato into thin strips for fries.
5. Fry Potato strips in the same pan with remaining Oil until golden and crispy.
6. In a small pan, melt Butter with minced Garlic over low heat.
7. Drizzle Garlic Butter mixture over the rested Beef Sirloin.
8. Top Beef Sirloin with Herb Butter before serving.
9. Serve Beef Sirloin with crispy Potato fries on the side.

Name: Chicken Fricassee
Preparation: 1. Cut Chicken into bite-sized pieces.
2. Melt Butter in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add Chicken to the pan and cook until browned.
4. Slice Mushrooms and add them to the pan with Chicken.
5. Pour Chicken Broth into the pan and bring to a simmer.
6. Stir in Heavy Cream, Dried Basil, and Dried Oregano.
7. Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes until Chicken is cooked through.
8. Beat Egg Yolk in a small bowl and slowly stir it into the pan to thicken the sauce.
9. Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Prawn Linguine in White Wine
Preparation: 1. Boil Linguine Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add chopped Garlic and sauté until fragrant.
4. Add Prawns to the pan and cook until pink.
5. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Paprika over the Prawns, stirring well.
6. Pour White Wine into the pan and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes.
7. Add Lemon juice and mix thoroughly.
8. Toss the cooked Linguine Pasta into the pan with the Prawns and sauce.
9. Stir everything together for 1-2 minutes, then serve hot.

Name: Beef Stroganoff (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Slice Beef Striploin into thin strips.
2. Cook Egg Noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain.
3. Sauté Mushrooms in a pan until golden.
4. Add Beef Striploin to the pan and cook until browned.
5. Stir in Beef Broth, Sour Cream, Mustard, Paprika, and Dried Oregano.
6. Simmer the mixture until the sauce thickens.
7. Serve the beef mixture over the cooked Egg Noodles.

Name: Duck Liver Pate with Toast (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Clean and trim the Duck Liver (80.0 g), removing any sinew or impurities.
2. Melt Butter (30.0 g) in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add finely chopped Shallots (10.0 g) to the pan and sauté until soft.
4. Add the Duck Liver to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes until browned on the outside but still pink inside.
5. Pour in Brandy (5.0 ml) and cook for another 1-2 minutes to deglaze the pan.
6. Season with Thyme (1.0 g), Dried Oregano (1.0 tsp), and Garlic Powder (1.0 tsp), stirring well.
7. Transfer the mixture to a blender and process until smooth to form a pate.
8. Slice the Baguette (80.0 g) into thin pieces and toast until golden and crisp.
9. Spread the Duck Liver pate on the toasted Baguette slices and serve immediately.

Name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
Preparation: 1. Toast the Sourdough Bread until golden and crisp.
2. Mash the Avocado in a bowl with Lemon Juice, Garlic Powder, and a pinch of Paprika.
3. Spread the mashed Avocado mixture evenly on the toasted Sourdough Bread.
4. Heat water in a pot to poach the Egg; gently poach the Egg for 3-4 minutes until the white is set but yolk is runny.
5. Place the poached Egg on top of the Avocado spread.
6. Drizzle Olive Oil over the Egg and Avocado Toast.
7. Sprinkle Chili Flakes and remaining Paprika on top for added flavor.
8. Serve immediately and enjoy.

Name: Shakshuka
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Chop Onion and Red Bell Pepper finely.
3. Sauté Onion and Red Bell Pepper in the pan until soft.
4. Add Tomato Puree to the pan and stir well.
5. Sprinkle Cumin & Paprika into the mixture and cook for 2 minutes.
6. Make small wells in the sauce and crack Eggs into them.
7. Cover the pan and cook until Eggs are set to desired doneness.
8. Serve hot directly from the pan.

Name: French Toast with Maple Syrup
Preparation: 1. In a bowl, whisk together the Egg, Milk, Cinnamon, Dried Oregano, and Garlic Powder.
2. Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the Butter.
3. Dip the Brioche Bread into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
4. Place the coated Brioche Bread in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
5. Remove from pan and drizzle with Maple Syrup before serving.

Name: Overnight Oats with Chia and Berries
Preparation: 1. In a bowl, combine 50.0 g of Rolled Oats and 100.0 ml of Almond Milk.
2. Add 10.0 g of Chia Seeds to the mixture and stir well.
3. Mix in 10.0 g of Honey for sweetness.
4. Gently fold in 40.0 g of Berries.
5. Sprinkle 10.0 g of Almonds on top.
6. Add 1.0 tsp of Garlic Powder and 1.0 tsp of Paprika, and mix lightly.
7. Cover the bowl and refrigerate overnight for the oats to soften.
8. Stir well before serving.

Name: Hash Brown Skillet
Preparation: 1. Grate the Potato (150.0 g) into thin shreds using a grater.
2. Finely chop the Onion (20.0 g).
3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add Butter (15.0 g) and Olive Oil (10.0 ml).
4. Add the grated Potato and chopped Onion to the skillet, spreading them evenly.
5. Season with Salt (2.0 g) and Black Pepper (1.0 g).
6. Cook for 5-7 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
7. Serve hot as a side dish.

Name: Vegetable Lasagna (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cook Lasagna Sheets in boiling water until al dente, then drain.
3. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of Marinara Sauce.
4. Place a layer of Lasagna Sheets over the sauce.
5. Spread Ricotta Cheese over the sheets, followed by a layer of Zucchini & Bell Pepper.
6. Add another layer of Marinara Sauce and sprinkle Mozzarella Cheese.
7. Repeat layers with remaining Lasagna Sheets, Ricotta Cheese, Zucchini & Bell Pepper, Marinara Sauce, and Mozzarella Cheese.
8. Top with Parmesan for a crispy finish.
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes until the cheese is melted and golden.
10. Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

Name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
Preparation: 1. Cook the Chicken Breast in a pan over medium heat until fully cooked, about 6-8 minutes per side.
2. Season the Chicken Breast with Paprika and Dried Basil while cooking.
3. Slice the cooked Chicken Breast into thin strips.
4. Lay the Flour Tortilla flat on a clean surface.
5. Place the Romaine Lettuce evenly over the Flour Tortilla.
6. Add the sliced Chicken Breast on top of the Romaine Lettuce.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan and Croutons over the chicken.
8. Drizzle Caesar Dressing evenly over the ingredients.
9. Fold the Flour Tortilla tightly to form a wrap.
10. Cut the wrap in half if desired, and serve immediately.

Name: Caprese Sandwich (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Slice the Ciabatta Bread horizontally to create a top and bottom half.
2. Drizzle Olive Oil on the cut sides of the Ciabatta Bread.
3. Sprinkle Garlic Powder and Paprika evenly over the oiled bread.
4. Layer Fresh Mozzarella slices on the bottom half of the bread.
5. Add sliced Tomato over the Fresh Mozzarella.
6. Place Fresh Basil leaves on top of the Tomato slices.
7. Drizzle Balsamic Glaze over the layered ingredients.
8. Place the top half of the Ciabatta Bread over the fillings to close the sandwich.
9. Serve immediately or lightly grill for a warm sandwich.

Name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
Preparation: 1. Drain the Canned Tuna and place it in a mixing bowl.
2. Finely chop the Celery and Red Onion, then add them to the bowl with the tuna.
3. Add Mayonnaise and Dijon Mustard to the tuna mixture.
4. Sprinkle in Dried Oregano and Dried Basil, then mix everything thoroughly.
5. Take two slices of Rye Bread and spread the tuna mixture evenly on one slice.
6. Place the second slice of Rye Bread on top to form a sandwich.
7. Cut the sandwich in half if desired and serve.

Name: Mushroom Risotto (Dinner Special) (Variation 2)
Preparation: 1. Finely chop the Onion.
2. Clean and slice the Mushrooms.
3. Heat Butter in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add chopped Onion to the pan and sauté until translucent.
5. Stir in Arborio Rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
6. Gradually add Vegetable/White Wine Broth, stirring constantly, until the rice absorbs the liquid.
7. Add sliced Mushrooms and continue to stir, adding more Broth as needed, until the rice is creamy and tender.
8. Sprinkle in Paprika and Dried Oregano, mixing well.
9. Stir in grated Parmesan until melted and combined.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Lamb Vindaloo
Preparation: 1. Marinate Lamb with Vinegar for 2 hours.
2. Grind Dry Red Chili and Garlic into a paste.
3. Heat Mustard Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Cumin Seeds and let them splutter for 30 seconds.
5. Add the Dry Red Chili and Garlic paste, and sauté for 2 minutes.
6. Add marinated Lamb and mix well to coat with spices.
7. Pour in Water, cover the pan, and simmer for 45 minutes or until Lamb is tender.
8. Stir occasionally and adjust consistency with more Water if needed.

Name: Classic Eggs Benedict
Preparation: 1. Split and toast the English Muffin until golden brown.
2. Cook the Canadian Bacon in a skillet over medium heat until lightly browned.
3. Poach the Eggs in simmering water for about 3-4 minutes until the whites are set but yolks are runny.
4. For the hollandaise sauce, melt the Butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk the Egg Yolk with Lemon Juice until smooth.
6. Slowly drizzle the melted Butter into the Egg Yolk mixture, whisking constantly to emulsify.
7. Add Dried Basil and Dried Oregano to the hollandaise sauce and mix well.
8. Assemble by placing the toasted English Muffin halves on a plate, topping each with Canadian Bacon, a Poached Egg, and a spoonful of hollandaise sauce.
9. Serve immediately.

Name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
Preparation: 1. Slice the Bagel in half horizontally.
2. Spread Cream Cheese evenly on both halves of the Bagel.
3. Layer Smoked Salmon on top of the Cream Cheese.
4. Sprinkle Capers over the Smoked Salmon.
5. Add thinly sliced Red Onion on top.
6. Garnish with Dill.
7. Dust with Garlic Powder and Paprika for added flavor.
8. Place the top half of the Bagel over the bottom half to assemble.

Name: Full English Breakfast
Preparation: 1. Heat a large frying pan over medium heat.
2. Add Pork Sausage and Bacon to the pan, cook for 8-10 minutes until browned and crispy, turning occasionally.
3. Remove Pork Sausage and Bacon from the pan and keep warm.
4. In the same pan, fry the Eggs to your desired doneness, about 2-3 minutes for sunny-side up.
5. Slice the Tomato in half and place cut-side down in the pan, cook for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
6. In a small saucepan, heat the Baked Beans over low heat for 3-5 minutes until warm.
7. Toast the Bread until golden brown.
8. Sprinkle Dried Oregano and Black Pepper over the Eggs and Tomato for seasoning.
9. Arrange Pork Sausage, Bacon, Eggs, Baked Beans, Tomato, and Bread on a plate.
10. Serve immediately.

Name: Steak and Eggs
Preparation: 1. Season the Beef Sirloin with Salt and Black Pepper on both sides.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the Beef Sirloin to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or to desired doneness.
4. Remove the Beef Sirloin from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes.
5. In the same skillet, melt Butter over medium heat.
6. Crack the Eggs into the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes for sunny-side up, or to desired doneness.
7. Serve the Beef Sirloin and Eggs together on a plate.

Name: Breakfast Burrito
Preparation: 1. Cook the Sausage in a skillet over medium heat until browned, then set aside.
2. In the same skillet, scramble the Egg until fully cooked.
3. Add Potato Hash to the skillet and cook until crispy and golden.
4. Season the mixture with Garlic Powder and Paprika, stirring well.
5. Warm the Flour Tortilla in a separate pan or microwave for a few seconds.
6. Place the cooked Sausage, Egg, and Potato Hash in the center of the Flour Tortilla.
7. Sprinkle Cheddar Cheese over the mixture.
8. Add Salsa on top of the filling.
9. Fold the Flour Tortilla, tucking in the sides to form a burrito.
10. Serve immediately or wrap in foil to keep warm.

Name: Pasta Primavera (Dinner Special) (Variation 2)
Preparation: 1. Boil Penne Pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
2. In a pan, heat Olive Oil over medium heat.
3. Add Asparagus & Peas and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
4. Add Cherry Tomato and cook for another 2 minutes.
5. Stir in Heavy Cream, Dried Basil, and Dried Oregano.
6. Add cooked Penne Pasta to the pan and toss to combine.
7. Sprinkle Parmesan on top and serve hot.

Name: Nicoise Salad (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Boil the Potato until tender, then cool and cut into bite-sized pieces.
2. Cook the Green Beans in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, then cool in ice water.
3. Peel and slice the Hard Boiled Egg into quarters.
4. Drain the Canned Tuna and flake it into a bowl.
5. Arrange the Potato, Green Beans, Egg, and Canned Tuna on a serving plate.
6. Add Black Olives on top of the salad.
7. Drizzle Olive Oil over the salad.
8. Sprinkle Dried Basil and Black Pepper evenly over the dish.

Name: Pork Belly Banh Mi (Fusion)
Preparation: 1. Slice the Baguette lengthwise and lightly toast it.
2. Cook the Pork Belly in a pan until crispy and golden brown.
3. Season the Pork Belly with Paprika and Dried Oregano while cooking.
4. Spread Mayonnaise on both inner sides of the toasted Baguette.
5. Layer the cooked Pork Belly on the bottom half of the Baguette.
6. Add Carrot & Radish on top of the Pork Belly.
7. Sprinkle Coriander and finely chopped Green Chili over the vegetables.
8. Close the Baguette and serve immediately.

Name: Continental Sausage Hash
Preparation: 1. Dice the Potato into small cubes.
2. Chop the Bell Pepper and Onion finely.
3. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
4. Add Pork Sausage to the pan and cook until browned.
5. Add diced Potato to the pan and cook until golden and tender.
6. Stir in chopped Bell Pepper and Onion, cooking until softened.
7. Sprinkle Paprika over the mixture and stir well to combine.
8. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, then serve hot.

Name: Eggs Florentine
Preparation: 1. Split and toast the English Muffin until golden brown.
2. Melt half of the Butter in a pan and sauté the Spinach until wilted.
3. Poach the 2 large Eggs in simmering water for about 3-4 minutes until the whites are set.
4. Prepare hollandaise sauce by whisking the Egg Yolk with Lemon Juice over a double boiler.
5. Gradually add the remaining melted Butter to the Egg Yolk mixture, whisking constantly until thickened.
6. Season the hollandaise sauce with Garlic Powder and Paprika.
7. Place the toasted English Muffin halves on a plate, top each with sautéed Spinach.
8. Add a poached Egg on top of the Spinach on each muffin half.
9. Drizzle the hollandaise sauce over the poached Eggs and serve immediately.

Name: Banana Walnut Pancakes
Preparation: 1. In a bowl, mash the Banana until smooth.
2. Add Flour, Buttermilk, and Egg to the mashed Banana, and mix well to form a batter.
3. Stir in chopped Walnuts, Dried Oregano, and Dried Basil into the batter.
4. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and melt Butter.
5. Pour a ladleful of batter onto the pan and spread it into a circle.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
7. Repeat with the remaining batter.
8. Serve hot.

Name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
Preparation: 1. Place 150.0 g of Cottage Cheese in a bowl.
2. Add 100.0 g of Pineapple, cut into small chunks, to the bowl.
3. Drizzle 10.0 g of Honey over the mixture.
4. Sprinkle 1.0 tsp of Paprika and 1.0 tsp of Dried Basil on top.
5. Garnish with 2.0 g of Mint Leaves.
6. Mix gently to combine all ingredients.
7. Serve immediately or chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes before serving.

Name: Lobster Thermidor
Preparation: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Melt Butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
3. Add Lobster Meat to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
4. Pour in Brandy and cook for another 1 minute to reduce slightly.
5. Stir in Heavy Cream, Garlic Powder, and Black Pepper, and simmer for 2 minutes.
6. Remove from heat and mix in Egg Yolk until well combined.
7. Transfer the mixture into a baking dish or lobster shells.
8. Sprinkle Gruyere Cheese evenly on top.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbly.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Chicken Cacciatore (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Heat Olive Oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add Chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
3. Remove Chicken and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add Bell Pepper and Mushrooms, and sauté for 5 minutes.
5. Stir in Tomato Puree and Red Wine, mixing well.
6. Return Chicken to the skillet, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes or until Chicken is cooked through.
7. Serve hot.

Name: Eggplant Parmesan (Dinner Special)
Preparation: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Slice Eggplant into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
3. Beat Egg in a bowl.
4. Mix Breadcrumbs with Paprika and Garlic Powder in a separate bowl.
5. Dip Eggplant slices in Egg, then coat with Breadcrumb mixture.
6. Heat Olive Oil in a skillet over medium heat.
7. Fry coated Eggplant slices until golden brown on both sides.
8. Place fried Eggplant slices in a baking dish.
9. Spread Marinara Sauce over each slice.
10. Top with Mozzarella.
11. Bake for 20-25 minutes until Mozzarella is melted and bubbly.
12. Serve hot.

Name: Gnocchi with Gorgonzola Sauce
Preparation: 1. Boil Potato Gnocchi in salted water until they float to the surface, then drain.
2. In a pan, melt Butter over low heat.
3. Add Gorgonzola Cheese to the pan and stir until it begins to melt.
4. Pour in Heavy Cream and mix until a smooth sauce forms.
5. Add the cooked Potato Gnocchi to the sauce and toss to coat evenly.
6. Sprinkle Walnuts and Black Pepper on top before serving.

Name: Pork Vindaloo (Traditional)
Preparation: 1. Cut Pork Shoulder into bite-sized pieces.
2. Marinate Pork Shoulder in Vinegar for 2 hours.
3. Grind Dry Red Chili, Garlic, Cumin & Cloves into a paste.
4. Heat Mustard Oil in a pan over medium heat.
5. Add the ground paste to the pan and sauté for 2 minutes.
6. Add marinated Pork Shoulder to the pan and mix well.
7. Sprinkle Paprika and Dried Oregano over the pork.
8. Pour Water into the pan and stir to combine.
9. Cover and cook on low heat for 45 minutes or until pork is tender.
10. Stir occasionally and adjust consistency with more Water if needed.

Name: Ratatouille Stew
Preparation: 1. Dice the Eggplant, Zucchini, Bell Pepper, and Tomato into small pieces.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a large pot over medium heat.
3. Add the diced Eggplant, Zucchini, and Bell Pepper to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes.
4. Stir in the diced Tomato and Herbes de Provence.
5. Pour in Water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Serve hot as a stew.

Name: Bruschetta
Preparation: 1. Slice the Ciabatta Bread into 1-inch thick pieces.
2. Toast the Ciabatta Bread slices until golden and crisp.
3. Rub the toasted bread with Garlic while still warm.
4. Dice the Tomato into small pieces.
5. Mix the diced Tomato with Olive Oil, Fresh Basil, Dried Basil, and Black Pepper in a bowl.
6. Spoon the Tomato mixture onto the toasted Ciabatta Bread slices.
7. Drizzle Balsamic Glaze over the top of each piece.
8. Serve immediately.

Name: Cheese Balls
Preparation: 1. Boil and mash Potato in a bowl.
2. Add Mozzarella Cheese to the mashed Potato and mix well.
3. Season with Oregano, Garlic Powder, and Paprika.
4. Shape the mixture into small balls.
5. Coat each ball with Cornstarch.
6. Roll the balls in Breadcrumbs to cover evenly.
7. Heat Oil in a pan over medium heat.
8. Fry the balls until golden brown on all sides.
9. Drain excess Oil on a paper towel.
10. Serve hot.

Name: Italian Lamb Chops
Preparation:
1. Season the Fish Fillet with Paprika and Dried Oregano.
2. Heat Olive Oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add chopped Onion and sauté until translucent.
4. Add chopped Tomato and cook until soft.
5. Place the seasoned Fish Fillet in the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
6. Meanwhile, cook White Rice in a separate pot according to package instructions.
7. Serve the cooked Fish Fillet with White Rice on the side, topped with the Onion and Tomato mixture.

Name: Rustic Caprese
Preparation: 1. Rinse and cook Lentils in a pot with water until tender, about 20-25 minutes, then drain.
2. Cook White Rice in a separate pot according to package instructions.
3. Finely chop Onion and Tomato.

7. Stir in cooked Lentils and White Rice into the pan with the Onion and Tomato mixture.
8. Season with Dried Oregano and Paprika, mixing well to combine.
9. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
10. Serve warm as a hearty dish.

Preparation: 1. Rinse and pat dry the Fish Fillet (154.0 g).

9. Serve the Fish Fillet over the cooked White Rice with the onion and tomato mixture on top.

7. Season the lentil mixture with black pepper and garlic powder. Stir well to combine the flavors.
8. To assemble the French Ravioli (Homestyle), create small pockets or patties by mixing a portion of the cooked rice with the lentil mixture. Alternatively, layer the rice and lentil mixture on a plate or in a baking dish.

Name: Gourmet Salad Variante
Preparation:

8. Serve chilled or at room temperature as a refreshing side dish.

Name: Gourmet Pasta
Preparation:

Name: Oven-baked Pork Chops (Special)
Preparation:
1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels.

6. Dice the onion and tomato into small pieces.
7. In a baking dish, spread the diced onion and tomato as a base layer.
8. Place the seared fish fillet on top of the onion and tomato mixture.
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
10. While the fish is baking, cook the white rice according to package instructions (typically, bring 1.5 cups of water to a boil, add the rice, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until tender).
11. Once everything is cooked, serve the oven-baked fish fillet over a bed of white rice, garnished with the baked onions and tomatoes.

Name: Oven-baked Baked Salmon Variante
Preparation:
1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).

6. While the salmon is baking, cook the white rice (91.0 g) according to package instructions (typically, rinse the rice, add it to a pot with water in a 1:2 ratio, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 15-20 minutes until tender).

8. Serve the baked salmon hot with the cooked white rice on the side, garnished with the baked onions and tomatoes from the dish.

Name: Mediterranean Quiche (Premium)
Preparation:
1. Rinse and cook the lentils in a pot of boiling water for about 20-25 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside.
2. In a separate pot, cook the white rice according to package instructions, typically boiling in water for 15-20 minutes until fluffy. Set aside.
3. Finely chop the onion and tomato.

7. Season the mixture with black pepper and dried basil. Stir thoroughly to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.
8. Cook for an additional 5 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally, to allow the flavors to meld together.

10. Serve warm as a hearty Mediterranean-inspired main course.

Name: Alpine Margherita Pizza
Preparation:
1. Cook the lentils: Rinse 100g of lentils under cold water. In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil, add the lentils, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.
2. Cook the white rice: Rinse 100g of white rice under cold water. In a separate saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil, add the rice, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes or until the rice is fluffy and fully cooked. Set aside.
3. Prepare the vegetables: Finely chop 50g of onion and 50g of tomato.
4. Sauté the vegetables: Heat 10g of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until translucent. Then, add the chopped tomato and cook for another 3-4 minutes until softened.
5. Season the mixture: Add 1 tsp of paprika and 1 tsp of dried basil to the pan. Stir well to combine the flavors.
6. Combine ingredients: Add the cooked lentils and rice to the pan with the vegetable mixture. Stir everything together to ensure the spices and vegetables are evenly distributed.
7. Cook together: Let the mixture cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally to allow the flavors to meld.
8. Serve: Transfer the Alpine Margherita Pizza mixture to a serving plate. Optionally, garnish with fresh basil leaves or a drizzle of olive oil before serving.

Name: Hearty Margherita Pizza (Homestyle)
Preparation:
1. Rinse and soak 86.0 g of lentils in water for about 4-6 hours or overnight to soften them. After soaking, drain the water and set aside.
2. Rinse 86.0 g of white rice thoroughly under running water until the water runs clear. Set aside.

11. Add the rinsed white rice to the pot, stir gently, and add more water if needed to cook the rice (approximately 1.5-2 cups).

13. Once cooked, check the seasoning and adjust with additional salt or spices if desired.
14. Remove from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
15. Serve hot as a wholesome main course, optionally garnished with fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil.

Name: Hearty Baked Salmon (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Place the salmon fillet in a baking dish.

11. Optionally, garnish with fresh herbs or a squeeze of lemon juice for added flavor.

Name: Bistro-style Steak (Homestyle)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Season both sides with garlic powder and dried oregano.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.

6. Meanwhile, cook the white rice according to package instructions (typically, bring 2 parts water to 1 part rice to a boil, then simmer covered for about 15-20 minutes until tender).
7. Place the cooked fish fillet back into the skillet with the onion and tomato mixture to reheat for 1-2 minutes, spooning some of the sauce over the fish.
8. Serve the fish fillet over a bed of cooked white rice, topped with the onion and tomato mixture.

Name: Greek Margherita Pizza (Special)
Preparation:
1. Cook the lentils and white rice separately according to package instructions until they are tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.

7. Cook the mixture for an additional 5 minutes on low heat, allowing the flavors to meld together. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
8. Once cooked, remove from heat and let it cool slightly. Serve warm as a hearty base or topping inspired by a Greek Margherita Pizza style.

Name: Gourmet Pork Chops (Homestyle)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Set aside.
2. Cook the white rice according to package instructions (typically, boil 113.0 g of rice in water until tender, about 15-20 minutes). Fluff with a fork and keep warm.

10. Serve the fish fillet over a bed of cooked white rice, topped with the onion and tomato mixture from the skillet.

Name: Tuscan Pork Chops (Spicy)
Preparation:
1. Prepare the Ingredients: Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Dice the onion and tomato into small pieces. Measure out the white rice, olive oil, black pepper, and garlic powder.

Name: Classic Steak (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels.

7. Meanwhile, cook the white rice according to package instructions (typically, rinse the rice, combine with water in a 1:2 ratio, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 15-20 minutes until tender).

9. Serve hot and enjoy your Classic Steak (Version 2)!

Name: Modern Lamb Chops (Premium)
Preparation:
1. **Prepare the Ingredients**: Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Dice the onion and tomato into small pieces. Measure out the white rice, olive oil, dried oregano, and paprika.

Name: Alpine Chicken Alfredo (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Set aside.

Name: Oven-baked Ratatouille
Preparation:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water and set them aside.

Name: French Salad
Preparation:
1. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water to remove any dirt or debris. Place them in a pot with enough water to cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 20-25 minutes or until tender. Drain any excess water and set aside to cool.

Name: Tuscan Minestrone (Special)
Preparation:

Name: Hearty Turkey Breast (Homestyle)

Name: Classic Caprese (Spicy)

Name: Oven-baked Pasta (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Rinse the lentils under cold water and cook them in a pot of boiling water for about 15-20 minutes or until they are partially cooked. Drain and set aside.

Name: Rustic Ravioli (Premium)

Name: Italian Quiche

Name: Hearty Meatballs (Version 2)

Name: Rustic Steak (Mild)

Name: French Lasagna (Mild)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. In a medium pot, add the lentils with 2-3 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for about 20-25 minutes or until tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.
2. In a separate pot, rinse the white rice and cook it according to package instructions (typically, 1 part rice to 2 parts water, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15-20 minutes until fluffy). Set aside once cooked.
3. Finely chop the onion and tomato. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent and fragrant.
4. Add the chopped tomato to the skillet and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato softens and forms a sauce-like consistency.
5. Stir in the garlic powder and dried oregano. Mix well to combine the flavors, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes.
6. Add the cooked lentils to the skillet with the tomato and onion mixture. Stir everything together to ensure the lentils are well-coated with the sauce. Cook for 5-7 minutes on low heat to let the flavors meld.
7. To assemble, layer the cooked white rice at the bottom of a baking dish or serving platter. Spread the lentil and tomato mixture evenly over the rice to mimic a lasagna structure.
8. Optionally, cover the dish with foil and bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10-15 minutes to warm through and enhance the flavors.
9. Serve hot as a hearty main course, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.

Name: Greek Margherita Pizza (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Rinse and cook the lentils in a pot with water until tender, about 20-25 minutes. Drain any excess water and set aside.
2. In a separate pot, cook the white rice according to package instructions until fluffy, then set aside.

4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent and slightly golden, about 3-5 minutes.
5. Add the chopped tomato to the skillet and cook for another 3-4 minutes until softened.
6. Stir in the cooked lentils and rice into the skillet with the onion and tomato mixture.
7. Season with dried oregano and paprika. Mix well to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.
8. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, to allow the flavors to meld together.
9. Serve hot as a hearty main course, optionally garnished with fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil.

Name: Italian Shrimp Scampi (Version 2)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the fish fillet under cold water and pat it dry with paper towels. Cut the fillet into bite-sized pieces if desired.
2. Cook the white rice according to package instructions. Set aside once done.
3. Finely chop the onion and dice the tomato.
4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until translucent and fragrant.
5. Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato softens.
6. Sprinkle dried basil and dried oregano over the onion and tomato mixture. Stir well to combine the flavors.
7. Add the fish fillet pieces to the skillet. Cook for 3-5 minutes on each side, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Be careful not to overcook.
8. Once the fish is cooked, gently mix everything together in the skillet to coat the fish with the sauce and seasonings.
9. Serve the Italian Shrimp Scampi over a bed of cooked white rice. Garnish with additional herbs if desired.

Name: Spanish Pasta (Homestyle)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. Soak them in water for about 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
2. Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs clear and set aside.
3. Finely chop the onion and tomato.
4. In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until it becomes translucent and soft, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the chopped tomato to the pot and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato softens and forms a sauce-like consistency.
6. Stir in the paprika and black pepper, mixing well with the onion and tomato mixture for about 1 minute to release the aromas.
7. Add the soaked and drained lentils to the pot, stirring to coat them with the spice mixture.
8. Pour in about 3 cups of water (or vegetable broth for added flavor) and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 20 minutes.
9. Add the rinsed white rice to the pot, stir well, and add more water if needed to cover the rice and lentils. Cover the pot and continue to simmer for another 15-20 minutes, or until both the rice and lentils are tender and have absorbed the liquid.
10. Check for seasoning and adjust with salt or additional spices if desired. Remove from heat and let it sit for 5 minutes before serving.
11. Serve hot as a hearty main course, optionally garnished with fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil.

Name: Rustic Risotto (Premium)

9. Mix in the cooked lentils and rice, stirring gently to coat them evenly with the sauce and spices. Cook for an additional 5 minutes on low heat to allow the flavors to meld together.
10. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. If desired, add salt and pepper to taste.
11. Remove from heat and let the risotto rest for a couple of minutes before serving.
12. Serve hot as a hearty main course, garnished with fresh basil leaves if available.

Name: Oven-baked Minestrone
Preparation:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Rinse the lentils under cold water until the water runs clear, then set aside.
3. In a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat on the stovetop.
4. Finely chop the onion and add it to the pot, sautéing for 2-3 minutes until translucent and fragrant.
5. Dice the tomato and add it to the pot along with the garlic powder and dried oregano. Stir and cook for another 2 minutes.
6. Add the rinsed lentils and white rice to the pot, stirring to combine with the onion and tomato mixture.
7. Pour in 4 cups (about 1 liter) of water or vegetable broth to cover the ingredients. Stir well.
8. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer on the stovetop, then cover the pot with a lid.
9. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the lentils and rice are tender and have absorbed most of the liquid. Check halfway through and stir if needed, adding a bit more water if it looks too dry.

Name: Modern Pork Chops (Homestyle)

Name: Italian Roast Chicken

1. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. In a medium pot, add the lentils with enough water to cover them by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for about 20-25 minutes or until tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.
2. In a separate pot, cook the white rice according to package instructions (typically, bring 1 cup of water to a boil, add the rice, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for about 15-20 minutes until the water is absorbed and the rice is fluffy). Set aside.
3. Finely chop the onion and tomato. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until translucent and soft.
4. Add the chopped tomato to the skillet and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato softens and forms a sauce-like consistency.
5. Stir in the cooked lentils and rice into the skillet with the onion and tomato mixture. Mix well to combine all ingredients evenly.
6. Add the dried oregano and dried basil to the skillet. Stir to incorporate the herbs, and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
7. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Remove from heat and let it sit for a couple of minutes before serving.
8. Serve the Italian-inspired gnocchi alternative warm as a hearty main course.

6. Combine and Serve: Once the fish is cooked, mix the vegetables with the fish in the skillet to combine the flavors. Serve the fish and vegetable mixture over a bed of the cooked white rice.
7. Garnish (Optional): Optionally, garnish with a sprinkle of extra dried basil or a drizzle of olive oil for added flavor before serving.

Name: Bistro-style Quiche (Mild)
Preparation:
1. Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear. In a medium saucepan, combine the lentils with 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.
2. In a separate pot, rinse the white rice under cold water. Add 1.5 cups of water to the rice, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 15-20 minutes or until the rice is fluffy and fully cooked. Set aside.
3. While the lentils and rice are cooking, finely chop the onion and tomato.
4. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes or until translucent and slightly golden.
5. Add the chopped tomato to the skillet and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomato softens and forms a slight sauce-like consistency.
6. Stir in the garlic powder and dried basil, mixing well to combine the flavors. Cook for an additional 1 minute.

10. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a pie dish or quiche pan with a little olive oil.
11. Spread the lentil and rice mixture evenly into the prepared pie dish, pressing it down gently to form a base and sides, mimicking a crust.
12. (Optional: If you’d like a more traditional quiche, you can whisk 3-4 eggs with a splash of milk and pour over the mixture at this stage. This step is optional for a milder, egg-free version.)

14. Remove from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve warm as a hearty main course, optionally with a side salad or steamed vegetables.

Name: Tuscan Lasagna (Spicy)

Name: Spanish Turkey Breast (Special)

Name: Italian Beef Stew

Name: French Pasta (Special)

Name: Spanish Quiche (Mild)
Preparation:

Name: Italian Meatballs (Special)

Name: Rustic Chicken Alfredo (Special)

Name: Mediterranean Roast Chicken
Preparation:

Name: Mediterranean Gnocchi (Version 2)

7. Adjust seasoning: Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more black pepper or a pinch of salt if desired.
8. Serve: Transfer the Mediterranean Gnocchi to a serving dish. Drizzle with a little extra olive oil if desired, and enjoy hot as a hearty main course.

Name: Oven-baked Risotto (Spicy)
Preparation:

2. Rinse the lentils and white rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then set aside.

5. Stir in the chopped tomato and cook for another 2 minutes until slightly softened.
6. Add the rinsed lentils and white rice to the dish, stirring to coat them in the oil and vegetable mixture.
7. Season with black pepper and dried oregano, mixing well to distribute the spices evenly.
8. Pour in about 500ml (2 cups) of water or vegetable stock, ensuring the rice and lentils are fully submerged.
9. Cover the dish with a lid or aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
10. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the rice and lentils are tender and have absorbed most of the liquid. Check halfway through and add a little more water if it looks too dry.
11. Remove from the oven, let it rest for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork before serving.

Name: Bistro-style Quiche (Homestyle)

Name: Alpine Minestrone Variante
Preparation:

Name: Bistro-style Gnocchi (Version 2)
